title: Køkkenleder til Julemærkehjemmet Skælskør
description:
Til vores køkken søger vi en køkkenleder, der har hjertet på rette sted, flair for økonomi og planlægning samt begejstring for ledelse og samarbejde. Som køkkenleder skal du kunne lede et alsidigt køkken med forskelligartede opgaver på Julemærkehjemmet. Du skal sammen med dit dedikerede team og andre fagpersoner omkring dig kunne skabe retningen for en varieret og sund mad. Vi ved, at det har afgørende betydning for et barns trivsel og udvikling.

 

Om Julemærkehjemmene
Julemærkefonden driver de fem Julemærkehjem, som hjælper børn året rundt. På Julemærkehjemmene lærer vi børn at indgå i fællesskaber, fordi det er forudsætningen for deres trivsel, læring og udvikling. Alt for mange børn i Danmark mistrives. De føler sig forkerte, de er ensomme, bliver mobbet, har ingen tro på sig selv og betragter fællesskaber udefra. Det må vi aldrig acceptere. Ingen børn fortjener en hverdag med ensomhed. 
Julemærkehjemmene giver børn og deres familier muligheden for en ny start. Børnene bor i en periode på Julemærkehjem sammen med andre børn, som også arbejder med deres udvikling. Forudsigelighed, inkluderende fællesskaber og den rette blanding af sund mad og bevægelse hjælper børnene til at finde deres fysiske, mentale og sociale styrker. Børnene opnår øget selvværd ved at lære nye måder at se sig selv og omverden på. 
Opholdet slutter, men udviklingen fortsætter, og de nye kompetencer følger med børnene hjem – et vigtigt afsæt for hele familien. 

Julemærkehjemmet Skælskør er et af fem Julemærkehjem i Danmark og ligger i smukke omgivelser ned til Skælskør Fjord. Julemærkehjemmet Skælskør har plads til 40 børn i alderen 7 til 14 år. Børnene bor på topersoners værelser fordelt på tre afdelinger: Højen, Skrænten og Fjorden.

Børnene er hjemme i weekenderne, hvor man skal øve sig på de nye vaner sammen med familien. Hverdagen på et Julemærkehjem er struktureret og tilrettelagt, så barnet har mulighed for at udvikle sig i et trygt fællesskab. 

Nærværende voksne, tydelige strukturer og plads til både bevægelse, leg og fordybelse er grundlaget for, at vi kan hjælpe børn i bedre trivsel. Under opholdet går barnet i skole på Julemærkehjemmet, hvor der undervises på mindre hold. Vi arbejder med børnenes fysiske, mentale og sociale sundhed gennem forskellige fælles aktiviteter i løbet af et ophold. Vi har tilrettelagt særlige forløb, hvor vi følger det enkelte barn og arbejder systematisk med at udvikle barnets kompetencer, handlemuligheder, styrker og glæde.

Vi samarbejder tæt med familierne, som vi har hyppig kontakt med – også gennem vores forældredage

Hvad er opgaven

Vi søger en køkkenleder som kan træde ind i opgaven hos os den 1. oktober 2026. 

Som køkkenleder er din opgave sammensat. Du vil skulle:

  • lede køkkenpersonale  
  • have løbende overblik over dit personales ressourcer og trivsel
  • have ansvar for den daglige personaleledelse, herunder vagtplanlægning
  • kunne sikre vagtplan, og ved sygdom og ferier sørge for et tilgængeligt vikarkorps til køkkenopgaven
  • planlægge madplan, indkøb og forplejning af børn, personale og gæster i huset
  • foretage indkøb af mad, tørvarer og diverse rengøringsartikler til hele huset.
  • deltage i tilberedning af maden, anretning og servering året rundt 
  • sikre overholdelse af budget og efterlevelse af politikker, egenkontrol og tilsyn
  • have ansvar for den daglige rengøring af køkken og tilsyn med rengøringsopgaven i hele huset
  • deltage i planlægning og aktivt medvirke i de arrangementer, som vi har i løbet af året 
  • deltage i udvalgsmøder, arbejdsmøder, ledelsesmøder og personalemøder
  • !!!!samarbejde med professionsbachelorer i ernæring og sundhed, herunder deltage i vores lokale udvalg ”Mad på Tværs”
  • samarbejde på tværs af Julemærkehjemmene med de øvrige køkkenledere
  • kunne tage praktikanter ind periodevist (f.eks. elever, jobprøvning mv.)
  • kunne løse forefaldende ad hoc-opgaver, bl.a. deltage i måltider med børnene ved behov.
     

Om dig 
Hvem er du?

Vi søger en køkkenleder, der har relevant uddannelse som økonoma, ernæringsassistent eller kok, gerne med en overbygning som kostfaglig leder eller anden ledelsesmæssig overbygning og erfaring.

Det er afgørende for at lykkes i stillingen, at du:

  • søger samarbejdet og er serviceorienteret
  • arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt men med respekt for at du har et team omkring dig
  • har erfaring med madproduktion til større grupper
  • har forståelse for - og gerne erfaring med - vagtplanlægning, økonomi, budget og indkøb
  • bidrager med godt humør og et mærkbart engagement for opgaven
  • ønsker at være en tydelig del af en hverdag med børn og kolleger
  • er loyal i forhold til de rammer og beslutninger vi har på Julemærkehjemmet og i Julemærkefonden
  • er udadvendt, imødekommende og har gode samarbejdsevner både internt og eksternt 
  • trives med at omgås børn og kan rumme mange mennesker dagligt
  • finder det positivt udfordrende at have mange opgaver, som indimellem skal jongleres.
  • laver sund og varieret mad, og kan udvikle vores mad og ernæring efter vores politikker og Fødevarestyrelsens anbefalinger
  • er struktureret og har god personlig planlægning
  • har overblik og får gjort opgaverne færdige
  • kan stå frem og holde oplæg omkring mad og måltider til et bredt publikum
  • kan arbejde ud fra og efterleve vores værdigrundlag som er: fællesskab – troværdighed – udvikling - engagement

 

Vores værdier og arbejdsmiljø 
Vi er en organisation med et stærkt menneskesyn og et klart formål: at skabe trygge fællesskaber, der styrker børn. På Julemærkehjemmene arbejder vi tværfagligt med høj faglighed, engagement og omsorg. Vores kultur er præget af samarbejde, åbenhed og lysten til at gøre en forskel. Vi tror på, at trivsel blandt medarbejdere smitter direkte af på børnene – derfor værner vi om et arbejdsmiljø med både faglig udvikling og plads til humor og hjertevarme.

 

Arbejdstid:

Stillingen er på 37 timer/ugen

 

Du varetager selvstændigt planlægningen af din tid, og det personale, som du er leder for. 

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt dagvagter, der vil dog forekomme aftenvagter, når der skal laves mad til gæster m.m. Du skal forvente at deltage i weekendarrangementer i løbet af året.

 

Reference:

Køkkenleder refererer til forstander. 

 

Det skal du vide:

Lønindplacering efter Kost- og Ernæringsforbundets kommunale overenskomst efter anciennitet.

Ansættelsesmyndighed er Julemærkefonden.

Ansættelsessted er Julemærkehjemmet Skælskør – Møllebakken 5 – 4230 Skælskør

Julemærkehjemmet Skælskør er en del af Julemærkefonden, som er en hjælpeorganisation drevet for indsamlede midler, og det forventes at du tager del i den lokale indsamlingsstrategi og agerer som ambassadør for vores hjælpearbejde.

Vi går som voksne foran og viser betydningen af et positivt fællesskab. Det betyder, at du er en rollemodel for både børn og voksne omkring dig.

Vi indhenter referencer inden aftale om ansættelse, ligesom det er et krav at der foreligger ren straffeattest og ren børneattest.

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 19 august

1. samtale forventes afholdt 26. august 2026 og eventuelt 2. samtale den 28. august 2026.

title: Lagermedarbejdere til stort transportfirma i Storkøbenhavn
description:
Har du lyst til et fysisk og aktivt job, hvor du bliver en vigtig del af et team, der sørger for, at varer kommer sikkert og effektivt videre? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til et stort og velrenommeret transportfirma vest for København.

Du bliver en del af et travlt logistikcenter tæt på motorvejsnettet og med gode muligheder for offentlig transport. Her håndteres der hver dag store mængder gods på tværs af Danmark og udlandet.

Dine opgaver

Dine primære opgaver bliver blandt andet:

  • Manuelt læs og los af lastbiler.

  • Håndtering og sortering af gods.

  • Sikring af korrekt placering og fordeling af varer.

  • Arbejde i et højt tempo med fokus på sikkerhed og kvalitet.

Arbejdet er fysisk krævende og passer godt til dig, der trives med at bruge kroppen og gerne vil have mange skridt i løbet af dagen.

Vi søger dig, som

  • Trives med fysisk og rutinepræget arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde effektivt og bevare overblikket.

  • Møder stabilt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Har en positiv indstilling og kan indgå i et fast team.

Arbejdstider og løn

Stillingen er fleksibel, og arbejdstiden varierer mellem 8 og 30 timer om ugen. Vagterne ligger som udgangspunkt mellem kl. 11.00 og 20.00, og du bliver en del af et fast team. Der kan forekomme variationer ved spidsbelastning.

  • Løn: 175,15 kr. i timen.

Sådan søger du

Du må gerne uploade dit CV og din ansøgning med det samme ved at trykke på “Søg stilling” på Jobnet. Bemærk, at ansøgninger sendt via mail ikke behandles.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om Medarbejderne ApS

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet vikar- og rekrutteringsfirma med en sund forretningsfilosofi og høj etisk standard. Vi har mere end 20 års erfaring med vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger på alle niveauer og arbejder for at skabe den rette kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager.

Medarbejderne ApS er landsdækkende og har kontorer i Horsens, Fredericia, Viborg, Hjørring, Hobro, Odense, Aabenraa og Ringsted.

title: Teknisk administrativ medarbejder til ejendomsdrift
description:
Har du styr på bygningsdrift og kendskab til byggegarantier? Drømmer du om at arbejde i en central rolle indenfor ejendomsdrift og som tæt sparringspartner for kollegaer? Trives du i en hverdag, hvor du primært arbejder fra kontoret i Silkeborg, men også af og til er ude på besigtigelser?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne lære dig bedre at kende!

Hos Dalbøges Ejendomsservice får vi flere opgaver og derfor søger vi en ny kollega, som får en central rolle i den daglige drift af de ejendomme, vi passer.

Du bliver bindeled mellem vores dygtige viceværter og kunder. Nogle dage er du ude og besigtige en ejendom, følger op på garantisager eller flyttesynsopgørelser. Andre dage sidder du på kontoret og udarbejder tilbud, planlægger opgaver eller hjælper med at få en ny ejendom godt i gang.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og et stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

HVORFOR ER DET LIGE NETOP DIG, VI ER PÅ UDKIG EFTER?

Du tager ansvar og får tingene til at ske.

Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften, og du trives med at finde løsninger sammen med både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·         Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift, bygningsdrift eller facility management.

·         Har en god teknisk forståelse og gerne en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

·         Har arbejdet med tekniske gennemgange, mangellister og/eller garantisager.

·         Har forståelse for flyttesyn og processerne rundt om synene.

·         Har lyst til at være den, som viceværterne kan sparre med i hverdagen, og sætter en ære i at deres opgaver er godt koordineret.

·         Er god til at skabe overblik og følge op på opgaver.

·         Er serviceminded og god til at skabe tillid hos kunderne.

·         Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

·         Sparring og planlægning af opgaver sammen med vores viceværter.

·         Besigtigelse af ejendomme, og udarbejdelse af tilbud og serviceaftaler.

·         Opstart af nye ejendomme og sikring af en god overgang til den daglige drift.

·         Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører.

·         Dialog med kunder, håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere.

·         Løbende udvikling af vores arbejdsgange og kvaliteten i driften.

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå ude på de ejendomme vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

VIL DU MED?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning.

Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

title: Driftsleder/Driftskoordinator
description:
Driftsleder / Driftskoordinator

MM Facility Cleaning vokser, og vi søger en erfaren driftsleder/driftskoordinator, der kan skabe struktur, styrke vores processer og sikre en professionel og stabil drift på tværs af kunder, medarbejdere og lokationer.

Du får en central rolle tæt på den daglige drift og bliver medansvarlig for, at vi arbejder med de rette systemer, tydelige procedurer og en ensartet kommunikation. Rollen kræver både overblik, handlekraft og forståelse for den praktiske virkelighed i rengøringsbranchen.

Brancheerfaring vil blive vægtet højt. Vi søger en profil, der kan kombinere praktisk driftsforståelse med struktur, ledelse og professionel opfølgning.

Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder:

Kvalitetssikring og driftsopfølgning
Du følger op på leverancer, kvalitet og kundeaftaler og sikrer et ensartet og professionelt niveau på tværs af vores lokationer.

Vagtplanlægning og bemanding
Du koordinerer vagtplaner, ferie, sygdom og ændringer og sikrer, at bemandingen understøtter både drift, kvalitet og kundernes behov.

Systemer, processer og procedurer
Du er med til at udvikle og implementere de systemer og arbejdsgange, der skaber overblik, tydelige ansvarsområder og en mere effektiv drift.

Medarbejderledelse og rekruttering
Du har løbende kontakt med medarbejderne, deltager i oplæring og opfølgning og er med til at rekruttere og onboarde nye kolleger.

Kundekontakt og koordinering
Du deltager i kundemøder, følger op på leverancen og sikrer, at aftaler og forventninger bliver omsat til klare handlinger i driften.

Praktisk driftsledelse
Du bidrager ved opstart af nye kunder, koordinering af materialer og udstyr samt øvrige opgaver, der understøtter en stabil og professionel leverance.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har gerne erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, facility management eller en anden driftsintensiv servicebranche.

  • Du har stærkt overblik og arbejder struktureret med planlægning, opfølgning og implementering.

  • Du er vant til at koordinere medarbejdere og kan skabe tydelighed, retning og fremdrift i hverdagen.

  • Du forstår betydningen af kvalitet, dokumentation og professionel kundekommunikation.

  • Du kan identificere behov for nye systemer eller procedurer og omsætte dem til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

  • Du kommunikerer sikkert på dansk eller engelsk og er fortrolig med almindelige digitale værktøjer.

Vi forestiller os, at du enten allerede arbejder i rengøringsbranchen eller kommer fra en beslægtet driftsrolle, hvor koordinering, personale, kvalitet og kundekontakt er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Arbejdstider og praktisk tilstedeværelse
Rollen følger ikke udelukkende almindelige kontortider. Der vil være kundebesøg og opfølgning på de tidspunkter, hvor rengøringen udføres, herunder enkelte aftener, nætter eller tidlige morgener.

Timer:
30–37 timer om ugen. Det præcise timetal aftales ud fra kandidatens kompetencer og den samlede rollefordeling.

Arbejdssted:
Kontor uden for Roskilde samt løbende besøg hos kunder og medarbejdere.

Transport:
Rollen indebærer, at du har kørekort.

Løn:
Efter aftale og kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning
Send en kort præsentation af dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor rollen passer til dig, til mads@mmfacility.dk

title: Houseman, Daytime: 11:00-16:30 (15-20 hours/week) ** CAN BE COMBINED WITH ANOTHER JOB **
description:
In everything we do, we believe in being sincerely caring in order to inspire trust and team work and so that we can enjoy and deliver happiness :-)

We’re looking for a Houseman to join our team at Motel One in Copenhagen - someone who takes pride in their work, cares about their team, and wants to be part of a positive and respectful working environment.

*** It is possible to combine this part-time job with another job; eg. an evening job that you might have somewhere else ***

---

The Role

This is a daytime housekeeping position, with working hours typically between 11:00 and 16:30 with some flexibility earlier or later when needed.

You will:

• Handle linen, waste, and supply distribution

• Assist with supplies and team efficiency

• Respond to ad hoc tasks and support where needed

• Contribute to a positive and respectful team atmosphere

---

About You

We are looking for someone who is motivated, reliable, and takes ownership of their work.

You:

  • Have experience in housekeeping or cleaning (preferred but not required)

  • Work well in a physically active and fast-paced environment

  • Are dependable and follow through on what you start

  • Take responsibility for completing your work to a high standard

  • Communicate clearly and respectfully

  • Enjoy working with people from different cultures and backgrounds

---

Practical Information

  • Working hours typically 11:00–16:30

  • Approximately 15-20 hours per week in average (Fixed schedule 3 days one week and 4 days the following week)

  • Every second weekend required

  • English required

---

What You Can Expect

  • Become part of a sincerely caring organisation focused on delivering happiness

  • Good terms of employment (from 164 DKK/hour + Sunday supplements + pension and private health insurance)

  • An international team of friendly and supportive colleagues

  • Lunch in the workplace

  • Monthly social events

  • A safe working environment with support, feedback, and attention from your colleagues and leaders

---

About Us – The Ellen Group

Everything we do, we do to deliver happiness. We strive to realize our vision by working on our mission every day: to reform the hotel housekeeping industry by delivering Worry-Free Housekeeping.

We sincerely care for our employees, and in turn our employees sincerely care for our customers. It’s really that simple.

...Commitment to quality... Continuously finding efficient ways to deliver the quality agreed with our customers.
...Consistency... We standardize our processes and train our employees to deliver a consistent level of service.
...and always with a smile! That is the Ellen way!

To learn more about The Ellen Group, please visit our website at www.theellengroup.com

or have a look at a documentary that was produced about how we work: 

https://www.tv2kosmopol.dk/stuepigerne-paa-bella-sky 

---

Join Us

To apply, please send your CV to job.dk@theellengroup.com
Please write “HM Motel One” in the subject field.

Our company is made up of people from over 30 nationalities. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and believe that diversity strengthens us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Kundeservicemedarbejder til Tønder Forsyning
description:
Kan du lide at hjælpe mennesker, skabe overblik og finde gode løsninger? Har du samtidig let ved at lære nye systemer og lyst til at være med til at udvikle måden, vi arbejder på? Så er du måske vores nye kollega. 

Hos Tønder Forsyning varetager vi vand, spildevand og affald/genbrug for kunder i Tønder Kommune. Kundeservice er kundernes indgang til virksomheden, og vi lægger stor vægt på at møde dem med høj faglighed, nærvær og god service. 

Nu søger vi en ny kollega til vores kundeserviceteam i Bredebro. 

Om jobbet 

Du bliver en del af en lille afdeling, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og løser opgaverne i fællesskab. 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at: 

  • besvare henvendelser fra kunder på telefon og mail 

  • løse administrative opgaver 

  • samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af organisationen 

  • sikre gode kundeoplevelser hver dag 

Du kommer også til at spille en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af kundeservice. Vi arbejder løbende med at forbedre arbejdsgange, udnytte nye digitale muligheder og gøre hverdagen lettere for både kunder og kolleger. Derfor forventer vi, at du byder ind med idéer, er nysgerrig på nye løsninger og aktivt bidrager til at udvikle måden, vi arbejder på. 

Hvem er du? 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • har erfaring med kundeservice eller lignende opgaver 

  • er imødekommende og god til mennesker 

  • har let ved at lære nye systemer og digitale værktøjer 

  • er nysgerrig og interesserer dig for, hvordan ting kan gøres smartere og enklere 

  • arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver 

  • trives med samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet 

Kendskab til forsyningsbranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

Vi tilbyder 

Du får en hverdag tæt på både kunder, kolleger og de løsninger, der får tingene til at hænge sammen. Vi er et sted, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling, og hvor gode input bliver taget alvorligt. Derfor får du mulighed for at bruge både din erfaring, din nysgerrighed og dit blik for god service i praksis. 

Stillingen er på fuld tid, og arbejdsstedet er Håndværkervej 4 i Bredebro. 

Vil du vide mere? 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kommunikationschef og konstitueret affalds- og kundeservicechef Betina Skjønnemand på telefon 5117 9086. 

Ansøgning 

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til ansogning@tonfor.dk hurtigst muligt. 

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: Herning - Lager - Container tømning
description:

title: Job i udlandet - Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser. Start med gratis professionel rådgivning af Cathrine, som bor i Spanien.
description:
Tag dit sabbatår i udlandet – få job, oplevelser og professionel rådgivning så du kommer trygt afsted.

Jeg hedder Cathrine, og jeg arbejder hos JobHuntWorldwide. Jeg kender følelsen af at stå med lysten til at tage af sted, men ikke helt vide, hvordan man gør det. Det er præcis derfor, jeg er her, til at gøre processen nem og tryg for dig.

Drømmer du om at bruge dit sabbatår på noget helt andet end hverdagen i Danmark? Jeg hjælper unge danskere med at finde arbejde i udlandet – både hvis du vil udvikle dig fagligt, møde nye mennesker eller bare prøve noget helt nyt for en periode.

Vi samarbejder med virksomheder i bl.a. Spanien, Grækenland, Portugal, Malta, Cypern, Vietnam og Filippinerne, og mange stillinger kræver ingen tidligere erfaring.

Hvad kan du forvente?

✔ Gratis og uforpligtende karrieresamtale

Vi starter altid med en personlig snak om dine ønsker for dit sabbatår. Vil du opkvalificeres? Vil du have et socialt fællesskab? Eller vil du bare prøve noget helt nyt? Jeg hjælper dig med at finde den løsning, der passer til dig.

✔ Hjælp til at finde det rette job

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Du skal som udgangspunkt kunne sige ja til 4–6 måneder, og du får naturligvis betalt ferie, så du kan rejse hjem undervejs.

✔ Professionel forberedelse til jobinterview

Når vi har fundet et match, præsenterer jeg dig for virksomheden og klæder dig på til interviewet. Du får:

  • Feedback på dit CV

  • Råd om spørgsmål du bør stille

  • Forventningsafstemning om bolig, løn, kontrakt og praktiske forhold

Jeg følger dig hele vejen frem til din første arbejdsdag.

Hvilke typer job kan du få?

Der er mange muligheder – alt efter dine ønsker og kompetencer. Eksempler:

  • Kundeservice og teknisk support

  • Rejsebranchen og booking

  • Telemarketing og mødebooking

  • Reception og administration

  • Fundraising

  • Online kundekommunikation

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Technically grounded
  • Possess strong leadership and people management skills
  • Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
  • Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
  • Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
  • Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
  • Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
  • Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
  • Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
  • Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
  • Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
  • Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
  • Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
  • Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
  • Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
  • Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
  • Pension – attractive employer contributions
  • Private healthcare and life insurance
  • On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
  • Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
  • A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
  • A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

title: Firefighting Service Engineer; Location DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you an experienced service engineer with a background in offshore operations and hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems? At Semco Maritime, we keep critical safety systems running on some of the world's most demanding offshore installations — and we're looking for someone who takes pride in doing that well.

Your position
As a Firefighting Service Engineer in our Technology Solutions division, you will join a close-knit Service Team based at our Global HQ in Esbjerg, Denmark. Your work will directly support the safety and reliability of offshore energy operations worldwide — from routine maintenance to complex troubleshooting in the field.

This is a full-time position with significant international travel (100+ days per year). If you thrive in a varied, hands-on role where no two weeks look the same, this could be a strong fit.

”This is a great opportunity to work worldwide with high performance fire protection systems, take on complex challenges and build valuable experience in a specialised engineering field” – Nikolaj Søegaard, Manager, Service Firefighting

Your tasks & responsibilities
You will be responsible for the delivery, coordination, and execution of firefighting service and maintenance across our on- and offshore client base. Day-to-day, this includes:
  • Servicing, troubleshooting, and supervising firefighting systems (Water Mist, Deluge, Foam, Argonite, and others)
  • Planning and executing maintenance and installation work onshore and offshore
  • Preparing and reviewing work packages, including Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS)
  • Providing remote technical support and contributing to tenders and quotations
  • Building client relationships and identifying service opportunities
  • Upholding health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities

Your profile & qualifications
We're looking for someone who is technically solid, safety-conscious, and comfortable working independently in demanding environments. You likely have:
  • A technical qualification in engineering or a related discipline (mechanical and/or electrical)
  • 1–5 years of experience in the offshore industry
  • Hands-on knowledge of firefighting systems in an operational setting
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working directly with clients
  • Relevant offshore certifications (e.g. BOSIET/OPITO) — or willingness to obtain them
  • Experience with work package preparation and safety documentation (RAMS)
  • The ability and willingness to travel 100+ days per year and work offshore

What we offer
You will be joining a high-performing, international team where safety culture is genuinely lived, not just stated. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, and your base will be at our Esbjerg HQ — on the waterfront, at the heart of the Danish energy industry. As Semco Maritime continues to expand our service capabilities, there are real opportunities to grow with us.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.

You will collaborate with highly skilled colleagues and can play a crucial role in designing offshore substations, from the tender phase through to commissioning.

Here, you will work with some of the brightest and most skilled engineers in developing technical solutions to our customers all over the world. You will have the exciting chance to bring your knowledge into work in the core area of high voltage systems. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You may choose working from our head office in Esbjerg or our Nordhavn office close to the centre of Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect 10-30 travel days per year.

“As part of the high voltage team, we get to contribute to some of the largest offshore substations the world has ever seen. You will travel to different countries and will be working with team members from multiple cultures. Further you will have the opportunity to involve in both the theoretical and practical aspects of offshore wind farm projects. This is done in an informal atmosphere with high focus on knowledge sharing and development,” says Colleagues from the Electrical department. 

Your tasks & responsibilities
In the role you will be responsible for driving part of the high voltage scope of the projects. You will be the technical design responsible of own scope and in cooperation with the project team oversee compliance of the time schedule and budget, to ensure the project's successful completion.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • Responsible for design, calculations and engineering of HV/MV equipment in our EPC projects.
  • Handling suppliers, negotiations and contracts in cooperation with the project team and procurement department.
  • Planning and potentially attending FAT, HAT, SAT, commissioning and handover of projects to clients and their O&M organisation.
  • Developing, optimizing and standardizing technical solutions, as well as participating and supporting tenders.

Your profile & qualifications
As a person you are dedicated and proud of what you do, you are trustworthy, positive and a team player. Furthermore, you should be able to collaborate with both external and internal stakeholders and have a proactive, analytical and organized approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we expect you to have:
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Electrical Power Systems or Electrical Installation Engineer.
  • Experience in designing high voltage components such as High- and Medium Voltage GIS and oil-immersed equipment.
  • Practical experience in the installation, testing, and commissioning of high voltage equipment, as well as knowledge of offshore design requirements, is beneficial.
  • An understanding of project management and detailed engineering from offshore substations or other relevant electrical projects.
  • Can communicate in English, both verbal and written.
  • You should be the go-to person for technical clarifications and possess a good sense of humour, which is always appreciated at Semco Maritime.

Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,400 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us. 
We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis starting from end of August due to holiday season in Denmark, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact Thomas V. M. Christiansen, Manager of the High Voltage Equipment Team at mail: tvmn@semcomaritime.com

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Sales, Administration and Marketing Apprentice (2-Year Program)
description:
Automobility-X is a growing company based in Ikast, Denmark, specializing in mobility and vehicle solutions. title: Vil du også være på den grønne gren?
description:
Er du uddannet pædagog, kan levere varmt nærvær i børnehøjde og være fagligt reflekterende i dit arbejde, er det dig vi leder efter

Om os

Akvariefisk, ulveskov og hverdagspædagogik er nogle af de ting, som findes i Børnehuset Derudá, hvor vi leder efter en pædagog til vores vuggestue nærmere bestemt Den Grønne Gren.

Her vil blandt andet David og Lene være dine nærmeste kollegaer. De er blandt meget andet 100 meter mestre i organisering, og har godt styr på overblikket. De er også meget åbne for dine idéer, hvis du har noget, som du brænder for pædagogisk.

Vi er et stort hus med med mulighed for åbne døre, men også med plads til ro og fordybelse bag en lukket dør til små grupper og større fællesskaber. Vi er både fælles og hver for sig.

Vi har en meget stor legeplads, hvor vuggestuen og børnehaven færdes frit. Her er svævebane, bålplads og et utal af krat, træer og gemmesteder til børnene.

Husets hjerte er køkkenfællesrummet, der binder vuggestuen og børnehaven sammen. Hver afdeling har også eget fællesrum, som vi i vuggestuen bruger til leg, musik og bevægelse.

Vuggestuen består af tre stuer (Orange Scene, Blåhvalen og Den Grønne Gren) med 11 børn på hver stue. Der går en hæk ned gennem vores legeplads, og ud fra hver vuggestue er der en lille gårdhave, hvor man bedre kan lave en afgrænset pædagogisk aktivitet. 

Vi tilbyder 

  • En arbejdsplads der vægter høj faglighed og sætter kerneopgaven i fokus. 
  • Tid til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.
  • En medarbejdergruppe som er optaget af at evaluere på egen praksis og skabe endnu bedre lege- og læringsmiljøer.
  • En vuggestue, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på strukturen og aktiviteter og være med til at udvikle praksis. 
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af huset. 
  • En masse dejlige børn og familier.
  • Koncentration i arbejdet med dagtilbud for alle og fokus på refleksion og evalueringskultur.
  • En fastansat sprogkonsulent i dagtilbuddet, som vi sparrer meget med.
  • Mulighed for at skifte stue eller afdeling, hvis opgaven kalder på det, eller man har ønske om det.
  • Opbakning til kurser og efteruddannelser.

Vi synes, det er fedt hvis du:

  • Formår at skabe gode læringsmiljøer og deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene og altid har fokus på kerneopgaven og barnets perspektiv – både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet.
  • Interesserer dig for børnenes intentioner og møder dem anerkendende og åbent samt er nysgerrig på, hvad der ligger bag deres handlinger.
  • Aktivt medvirker til udvikling, planlægning, gennemføring, evaluering og dokumentering af pædagogiske forløb.
  • Kan bringe dig selv i spil, gå forrest og give følgeskab, i dagligdagen og i samarbejdet med kollegaer og forældre.
  • Kan lide at lege og forstår vigtigheden af voksen indlevelse og deltagelse i børns leg.
  • Kan kommunikere professionelt med forældre, kollegaer og ledelse og ønsker at sparre, så vi sikrer god kvalitet.  
  • Er smilende og imødekommende, og at du er bevidst om, at du er en vigtig rollemodel i mange forskellige sammenhænge.

Ansøgning

Vi er ikke så vilde med traditionelle ansøgninger, og måske er du heller ikke. Derfor ønsker vi, at du sender et dokument, hvor du svarer på disse 5 spørgsmål. Svarene vil give os et bedre indblik i dig som pædagog og din faglighed.

  1. Fortæl om et barn, du havde svært ved at skabe relation til. Hvad gjorde du? Og hvad lærte du?
  2. Hvad er god pædagogik i en vuggestue efter din mening?
  3. Hvordan balancerer du omsorg og tydelige rammer?
  4. Hvilken rolle mener du, den voksen skal have i børns leg?
  5. Fortæl om noget, du har ændret mening om i dit pædagogiske arbejde gennem tiden og hvorfor. 

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 men også gerne før.

Ansøgningsfrist:  14. august 2026
 
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer, medmindre stillingen er omfattet af en forhåndsaftale, som kan danne grundlag for lønfastsættelsen
  
Ugentligt timetal: 37

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kan du se dig selv i noget af ovenstående, eller har du nogle spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Hornemann på 23 37 20 27 eller på hornemann@aarhus.dk. Du kan også kontakte David – der er pædagog på Den Grønne Gren på 21266592.

Se mere om os på vores hjemmeside Børnehuset Derudá

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.   

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.
