title: Elektrotekniker eller tekniker/laborant med elkompetencer - DTU Sustain
description:
Har du erfaring med forskning og feltarbejde og en baggrund som elektrotekniker eller tekniker/laborant med elkompetencer, så er her et virkelig spændende og alsidigt job på DTU Sustain.

Vores garvede kollega varmer op til at gå på pension, og vi ønsker os derfor brændende at finde en kompetent erstatning, som kan overtage hans lidt utraditionelle job. Er du habil til at reparere elektriske apparater, bygge forsøgssetup og lave elektriske installationer? Er du kreativ og skarp med erfaring for at fortolke forskeres krøllede tanker og gøre dem til virkelighed? Nyder du at arbejde i skovbunden, i toppen af en mast såvel som i et klassisk laboratorie – så er du måske vores nye kollega.

I vores afdeling for feltarbejde hjælper vi instituttets forskere og studerende med at komme fra tanke til handling og dermed gøre videnskab håndgribeligt. Opgaverne spænder bredt – fra forsøg hvor vi undersøger hvilken risiko f.eks. PFAS og andre miljøfremmede stoffer udgør for vores miljø til at undersøge klimaforandringernes effekt på CO2-kredsløbet.

Hos DTU Sustain bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen og udvikling prioriteres højt. Fagligt engagement og god trivsel går hånd i hånd, så derfor tilbyder vi fleksibel planlægning af arbejdsdagen og en arbejdsplads med fokus på work-life-balance

Jobbet
Stillingen er i høj grad ”hands-on”, hvor du vil have din daglige gang på vores forskellige felt-sites, på værkstedet eller i laboratorierne på DTU i Lyngby. Opgaverne kan f.eks. omfatte:
  • Drift og vedligehold af vores installationer på vores forsøgssites i skov og i master – f.eks. ved at sikre funktion af sensorer og måleenheder, så dataopsamling fungerer.
  • Design og opbygning af konstruktioner og forsøgsinstallationer ud fra forskeres ideer
  • Reparation af måleudstyr
  • Ombygning af udstyr, så det passer til situationen
  • Ansvarlig for at sikkerheden holdes for klatreudstyr, master og stilladser

Du får en alsidig arbejdsdag, hvor du indgår i forskellige forskningsprojekter og har tæt samarbejde med vores forskere og indimellem studerende. Vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok, og stillingen indebærer derfor også forskellige driftsopgaver på tværs af gruppen, såsom udstyrsansvar, rumansvar og bidrag til afholdelse af kurser for studerende.

Din baggrund og kompetencer
Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse som elektrotekniker eller måske er du helt ideelt både uddannet laborant og elektriker. Det er et krav, at du skal have kørekort og gerne til stor trailer. Derudover vil det særligt være et plus, hvis du:
  • har erfaring med el-arbejde i et eller andet omfang.
  • har flair for at arbejde i et værksted og brug af værktøj
  • har erfaring med forskellige former for prøvetagning i felten
  • er kreativ, nysgerrig og lidt en Ole-opfinder-type.
  • nyder at bygge og konstruere ting og kommer i mål selv om ”vejledningen er lidt kringlet”
  • er struktureret og god til at holde overblik
  • er en teamplayer, men trives med at arbejde alene

Du trives i et afslappet arbejdsmiljø, hvor tonen er uformel og hvor faglighed og teamspirit vægtes højt. Du er engageret og selvstændig, og du er positiv og åben overfor, at arbejdsdagen måske ikke altid forløber som planlagt. For dig er det naturligt at have et smil på læben, når du hjælper en kollega.

Du har gode samarbejdsevner og formår at indgå i dialog på engelsk med vores ansatte, studerende og gæster, hvoraf mange kommer fra udlandet. Det er det vigtigt, at du formår at tage ansvar for at prioritere dine opgaver og koordinere dit arbejde med kolleger og forskere.

Din arbejdsplads
På DTU Sustain arbejder vi med miljø- og ressourceteknologi. Vi udvikler løsninger på de konkrete problemstillinger, som mennesker og samfund står overfor lige nu. Vores feltafdeling er en del af fælleslaboratorierne, der p.t. bemandes af 14 personer. Fælleslaboratoriet favner, udover feltarbejde, alt fra analyselaboratorier med organisk og uorganisk kemi over opsætning af bio-reaktorer til mikrobiologi og molekylærbiologi - så du har mange muligheder for at udvikle dig fagligt hos os.

DTU Sustain er en af de førende forsknings- og uddannelsesinstitutioner på miljøområdet globalt. Vi prioriterer tværgående samarbejde mellem forskningsområder og personalegrupper i et internationalt aktivt uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø til gavn for det danske samfund.

Du får
  • Et interessant og udfordrende job i en international atmosfære med fokus på forskning, undervisning, innovation og videnskabelig rådgivning til gavn for det omgivende samfund. Vi lægger vægt på professionalisme og et højt fagligt niveau blandt vores medarbejdere, så kompetenceudvikling er en integreret del af vores organisation.
  • Et job, hvor projekterne favner bredt rent fagligt. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er fagligt skarp og frisk på at lade dig udfordre og gribe forskelligartede opgaver.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj trivsel og god work-life-balance. Det er vigtigt for os, at vores medarbejdere trives fagligt og som mennesker. Vi skal håndtere mange opgaver, men vi ser en sport i at få dem prioriteret, så hverdagen er sjov og effektiv.
  • En høj grad af fleksibilitet i dit arbejdsliv, da du får stor indflydelse på at planlægge arbejdet indenfor dit ansvarsområde.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK/Stat), Håndværkere og teknikere eller Ingeniørassistenter og forskningsteknikere ved forskningsinstitutioner mv.

Der kan desuden forhandles tillæg i henhold til DTU's lønstruktur for HK Laborant eller DTU's lønstruktur for teknikere, håndværkere og visse assistenter m.fl.: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/human-resources/under-ansaettelsen/loen/loenstrukturer

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid med forventet start 1. oktober eller hurtigst muligt.

Arbejdspladsen er på DTU i Lyngby.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Vi skal modtage din online ansøgning senest den 23. august 2026. Åbn linket "Ansøg nu", hvor du udfylder ansøgningsformularen samt vedhæfter motiveret ansøgning, CV og eksamensbeviser.

Ønsker du flere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte laboratoriechef Cathrine Tamstorf på +4593510140.

Læs mere om DTU Sustain her: https://sustain.dtu.dk/

Ansøgninger modtaget efter ansøgningsfristens udløb tages ikke i betragtning.

Alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen. Da DTU arbejder med forskning i kritisk teknologi, hvormed der gælder særlige regler for blandt andet sikkerhed og eksportkontrol, kan der blive foretage open source-baggrundstjek af kvalificerede kandidater til stillingen.

DTU Sustain - Institut for Miljø- og Ressourceteknologi - er et af de største universitetsinstitutter i Europa med speciale i miljø- og ressourceteknologi. Instituttet udfører forskning, udvikling og forskningsbaseret rådgivning og leverer uddannelsesprogrammer og service til samfundet. Vi arbejder på at udvikle nye miljøvenlige og bæredygtige teknologier, metoder og løsninger samt at formidle denne viden til samfundet og nye generationer af ingeniører. Instituttet har cirka 300 medarbejdere med mere end 30 nationaliteter.

DTU – Til gavn for samfundet siden 1829
DTU er et af Europas førende tekniske eliteuniversiteter. Med forskning og uddannelser i international topklasse skaber vi løsninger på tidens store samfundsmæssige udfordringer og bidrager til at sikre Europas globale førerposition inden for bæredygtig teknologiudvikling. Siden H.C. Ørsted grundlagde DTU for snart 200 år siden, har vores mission været den samme: Vi udvikler og nyttiggør naturvidenskab og teknisk videnskab til gavn for samfundet. DTU har 13.800 studerende, 1.600 ph.d.-studerende og 6.500 ansatte. Vi arbejder i et internationalt miljø og har en inkluderende, udviklende og uformel arbejdskultur. DTU har campusser i hele Danmark og i Grønland og samarbejder med de bedste universiteter verden over.

title: Senior Automation Manager, Nørresundby, Denmark
description:
Are you our new Automation Manager with a passion for technology, leadership, and scalable automation solutions?

At DESMI, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our automation capabilities across the organization. You will be part of product development & innovation leading a skilled engineering team in Denmark and China to develop reliable and future-proof automation solutions for both products and customized needs.
Working closely with Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, you will ensure strong alignment between technical solutions and business requirements. You will be responsible for setting direction, creating structure across projects, and ensuring high quality delivery of automation solutions across DESMI’s global operations.
DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where collaboration, continuous learning, and professional development are at the core of our culture. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence the direction of our automation landscape, develop your team, and contribute to building scalable and efficient solutions that support our continued growth.

Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Technically grounded
  • Possess strong leadership and people management skills
  • Structured and organized

A glimpse into the role
You will lead a team of automation engineers while ensuring that our solutions are robust and aligned with business needs. Your primary responsibilities will include:
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing automation team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Project Execution & Prioritization: Plan, structure, and drive execution across multiple automation projects, ensuring clear priorities, efficient resource allocation, and on-time delivery.
  • Technical Direction & Quality Assurance: Set the technical direction for automation solutions across hardware and software, ensuring reliable, serviceable, and future-proof designs.
  • Operational Ownership of Automation Solutions: Oversee the development and maintenance of automation systems, translating business and product requirements into standardized, scalable technical solutions.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the key point of contact for stakeholders across Product Management, Projects, Production, and Service, ensuring alignment and clear communication on scope, expectations, and deliverables.
  • Process & Solution Optimization: Drive structured and transparent workflows across projects, continuously improving processes and enabling efficient and consistent delivery of automation solutions.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI’s automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

Your next opportunity starts here
We’re looking for an experienced and driven leader with a strong technical foundation in automation and a passion for developing both people and solutions. You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

We also imagine that you:
  • Have minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
  • Bring a strong technical background within automation, electrical engineering, or a similar field, combined with hands-on experience in both hardware and software design
  • Are structured and capable of creating clarity and overview in complex project environments with multiple ongoing activities
  • Have strong planning and resource management skills, enabling you to prioritize effectively and ensure successful project execution
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels
  • Take a solution-oriented approach and are comfortable setting direction while supporting your team in delivering robust and scalable solutions
  • Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success
  • Are fluent in English, as it is DESMI’s corporate language

The perks of being at DESMI
  • Flexible working hours – including possibilities for remote work.
  • Global career prospects – work with colleagues across Europe, Asia, and the U.S.
  • Skills development and career growth – Training, job rotation, and internal mobility
  • Pension – attractive employer contributions
  • Private healthcare and life insurance
  • On-site canteen – light breakfast, lunch buffet, and snacks
  • Company sports & social activities – from badminton and bowling to art clubs and summer parties

What we’re about
But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.
When you join DESMI, you can expect:
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
  • A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
  • A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.
As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?
If you're a dedicated and motivated individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

To learn more about this please contact Søren Flummer (SORF@desmi.com). We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Finance Assistant, Nørresundby, Denmark

What we’re about
At DESMI, teamwork and innovation drive success. We have a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together and ideas are always welcome.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve industries worldwide — from Aquaculture and Green Technologies to Defense. We focus on developing high-performance, long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Here, doers thrive — if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

Ready to apply?

We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

title: Karrosseritekniker, pladesmed eller dygtig svejser søges nær Auning
description:
Har du erfaring med karrosseriarbejde, pladearbejde eller svejsning – og sætter du en ære i at levere et solidt stykke håndværk?

Rekruttering Djursland søger på vegne af en virksomhed nær Auning en dygtig og stabil medarbejder til en alsidig hverdag med reparation, tilpasning og svejsearbejde.

Du kan være uddannet karrosseritekniker, pladesmed, smed eller have opnået tilsvarende kompetencer gennem praktisk erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har hænderne godt skruet på og kan arbejde omhyggeligt og selvstændigt.

DINE ARBEJDSOPGAVER

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

- Reparation og tilpasning af karrosseri- og pladedele

- Svejsning og øvrigt metal- og konstruktionsarbejde

- Opretning, udskiftning og montering af dele

- Klargøring og efterbehandling af udførte opgaver

- Fejlfinding og vurdering af den rigtige reparationsmetode

- Kvalitetskontrol af dit eget arbejde

- Andre praktiske opgaver på værkstedet

De konkrete arbejdsopgaver bliver tilpasset din erfaring og dine faglige kompetencer.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

- Har erfaring med karrosseri, pladearbejde, svejsning eller beslægtede opgaver

- Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

- Har sans for kvalitet, finish og præcision

- Er praktisk anlagt og god til at finde løsninger

- Er mødestabil og bidrager positivt til samarbejdet

- Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

- Gerne har kørekort B

En relevant uddannelse og svejsecertifikater er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og de rette håndværksmæssige evner kan være mindst lige så vigtige.

VIRKSOMHEDEN TILBYDER

- En alsidig arbejdsdag med forskellige faglige opgaver

- Gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold

- Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort vej fra idé til handling

- Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

- Mulighed for faglig udvikling og mere ansvar

- Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

- En fast fuldtidsstilling for den rette medarbejder

ARBEJDSSTED

Virksomheden ligger i området ved Auning på Djursland.

ANSØGNING

Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette medarbejder. Samtaler afholdes løbende, og opslaget kan derfor blive lukket, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Send dit CV eller en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring til Rekruttering Djursland via kontaktoplysningerne i annoncen.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os for en uforpligtende samtale.

Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

title: Driftstekniker med veludviklede samarbejdsevner og bred indsigt i service og drift af tekniske anlæg
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste fysiske rammer for Solrød Kommunes borgere og medarbejdere? 

Er du en serviceorienteret tekniker, der motiveres af at løse tekniske udfordringer? Har du samtidig blik for egne faglige begrænsninger og for, hvornår der skal trækkes på eksterne samarbejdspartnere? Og kan du kommunikere og samarbejde med mange forskellige mennesker? 

Så er du, måske den driftstekniker vi leder efter.

Arbejdsopgaverne 

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver:  

  • Ansvar for drift og anlæg af tekniske anlæg i samarbejde med dine kollegaer i et 3-mandsteam
  • Samarbejde med projektledere og kolleger om projekter, der skal reducere ejendommenes energiforbrug, med fokus på proces- og energioptimering
  • Servicering, reparation, styring og optimering af ejendommenes tekniske anlæg, herunder energi-, ventilation-, ADK-, og sikringsanlæg
  • Oprettelse og vedligeholdelse af registreringer af tekniske anlæg i FM-systemet Dalux

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi søger en alsidig driftstekniker til vores teknikteam i Drift og Anlæg. Har du relevant erfaring med drift af CTS-, ventilation-, CIS og eventuelt ABA-anlæg, og er dine hænder skruet rigtigt på, er det måske dig, vi mangler. 

Du skal være indstillet på at varetage opgaver selvstændigt, da opgaverne oftest bestilles af brugerne på vores ejendomme via Dalux. Vi lægger vægt på, at du er fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag.

Du skal have lyst til at møde mange mennesker i løbet af en arbejdsdag, og trives i en afvekslende rolle med både skruetrækker og tablet/pc i hænderne. 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en stærk teknisk baggrund og solidt kendskab til CTS-styring
  • Har en håndværksmæssig baggrund
  • Er serviceminded og engageret
  • Er fleksibel og kan tilpasse dig ændringer
  • Kommunikerer klart og præcist
  • Har humor og bidrager positivt til arbejdsfællesskabet
  • Er en erfaren IT-bruger og gerne har erfaring med Dalux og Microsoft Office
  • Kørekort til kategori B

Om jobbet

Du bliver ansat i Center for By og Bæredygtighed, hvor vi er ca. 85 medarbejdere. Du bliver en del af afdelingen Drift og Anlæg, hvor du får 43 fantastiske og engagerede kollegaer. Heraf sidder 15 medarbejdere på rådhuset, mens 28 er tekniske servicemedarbejder og driftsteknikere, som arbejder ude i marken, og som du primært bliver en del af.

Solrød Kommune har høje ambitioner for drift og vedligeholdelse af de kommunale ejendomme. Drift og Anlæg fungerer som kommunens driftsherre- og bygherreorganisation. Vi står for driften af alle kommunens ejendomme samt vej- og parkområdet.

Vi søger en engageret medarbejder, der ønsker at udvikle sine kompetencer inden for teknisk bygningsdrift og vedligeholdelse. Du får en inspirerende og travl hverdag med en stor kontaktflade til brugerne af kommunens ejendomme. Det gælder blandt andet ledere og medarbejdere i daginstitutioner, på skolerne, på rådhuset, i Genoptræningscentret og i Familiehuset m.fl. 

Løn

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer om ugen ekskl. frokost Løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

Stillingen indplaceres efter anciennitet og på den relevante faglige overenskomst. Lønnen fastsættes ud fra kvalifikationer og efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Vi forestiller os et lønniveau på maksimum 456.000 kr. årligt, hertil pension på omkring 15 % afhængig af overenskomstområde. 

Solrød kommune har indgået en fleksibel arbejdstidsaftale, som giver en vis grad af personlig frihed til at planlægge din arbejdstid.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte projektkoordinator Susanne Roed på mobil:  23 28 12 35 eller driftstekniker Michael Øhlenschlæger på mobil 21 13 44 89.

Ansættelsesforløb

Send en personlig ansøgning, som ikke er AI-genereret, men som afspejler din motivation og din relevante erfaring. Ansøgningen skal sendes via ansøgningsportalen for at komme i betragtning. Vedlæg eksamens- eller uddannelsesbeviser, eventuelle relevante kursusbeviser samt dokumentation for erfaring indenfor faget.

 


I Solrød Kommune gør vi en forskel sammen med borgerne. Vi arbejder for at virkeliggøre byrådets vision om, at Solrød skal være det bedste sted at leve og bo. Som arbejdsplads er vi et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter opgaverne på tværs af institutioner og afdelinger, og hvor du som medarbejder er en vigtig medspiller. Vi er i bevægelse og har hele tiden fokus på at lære og blive bedre. Vi tager ansvar for at løse opgaverne med blik for helheden, og du har som medarbejder indflydelse på løsningen af opgaverne og på din arbejdsplads.

title: Operatør daghold
description:
For en af Danmarks førende asfalt producenter søger ranstad en blandeoperatør til en alsidig hverdag

For vores samarbejdspartner nær Billund beliggende i Vandel søger Randstad en operatør til en spændende og alsidig fuldtidsansættelse hos en virksomhed, hvor du sjældent oplever to dage, der er ens.

Om stillingen
Kan du se dig selv i en produktionsvirksomhed med ansvar for at betjene, omstille og overvåge produktionsanlæg? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Du får en grundig sidemandsoplæring og et trygt introforløb, så du bliver klædt godt på til hverdagen på vores asfaltblandestation. Her bliver du en del af et mindre hold, der i fællesskab sørger for, at driften kører smurt, og at de vognmænd, der henter læs hos os, får en god service.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende, men vi lægger vægt på, at du har god teknisk forståelse. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med betjening af produktionsanlæg og procesforståelse – for eksempel fra en baggrund som proces- eller industrioperatør, landmand eller maskinfører med kendskab til fejlfinding og reparation. Det er desuden et plus, hvis du har truckcertifikat, men det er ikke et krav.

Mødetider
Produktionen starter kl. 05.00 om morgenen, og du ansættes på 37 timer om ugen. Da arbejdet til dels er sæsonpræget, skal du i højsæsonen forvente op mod 45-50 timer om ugen. Alt over 37 timer aflønnes med tillæg efter overenskomsten.

Arbejdsopgaverne er:
• Overvågning og indstilling af anlæg
• Kvalitetssikring af anlæg
• Fejlfinding og reparation af anlæg

Vi forventer:
• Du har enten en baggrund og eller erfaring indenfor de ovennævnte områder
• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil
• Du er selvkørende og selvstændig men kan arbejde i teams
• Du er udpræget A menneske

Vi tilbyder:
• Overenskomstmæssige forhold
• Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar i dine opgaver
• Fastansættelse fra start

Ansøg
Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Kitt Husted på 92921326. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt. Vi ansætter snarest mulig.

Om randstad
Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

title: Do you want a job you actually look forward to?
description:
Full time | 37 hours per week | Start 10 August | Copenhagen

Good pay, a day full of people, and the chance to help build something from the ground up.

We work with some of the biggest charities in Denmark, and we are looking for new Fundraising Consultants to join our team in Copenhagen full time. We are growing fast. You come in early enough to shape both the team and the company.

What is the job?

Face to face and door to door fundraising. You meet people where they are, at their door, in the street, in shopping centres and at events, and you have short, real conversations about causes that matter.

The goal is simple. Get more people to support organisations that make a difference.

What you get

  • Good pay

  • Full time, 37 hours per week

  • Fixed start date 10 August

  • Proper training from day one

  • Ongoing coaching and feedback from your team leaders

  • A young, social team with high energy

  • Team activities and social events

  • A fast route to more responsibility and more pay. We are growing, so your opportunities grow too

  • Real experience in communication, sales and people

What our fundraisers say

"The best part of fundraising is the mix of people and progress. You learn to communicate in a completely different way, and you can feel yourself getting better week by week. On top of that it is a strong team, where everyone helps each other improve." Matias, Fundraiser

What is a normal day?

You start the morning with your team. Informal, loud, social. Then you head out and work alongside your team, with your team leaders there for support and feedback throughout the day.

You will be challenged constantly. You will never be on your own.

Who fits?

You are a good fit if you:

  • enjoy talking to people

  • want to get better at communicating

  • work well with targets and structure

  • like being part of a team

  • show up on time and take responsibility

  • do not fold after the first no

No experience needed. We teach you everything.

In short

A full time job with good pay, a strong team, and real development, working on something that matters while helping build something big.

Sound like you?

Fill in the application form here: https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

It takes a few minutes. We interview on a rolling basis. Start date is 10 August and rolling after that.

Questions? Call +45 25 78 10 13

title: CTS-Projektteknikker
description:
CTS-Projektteknikker med ambitioner om mere? Bliv en del af ALTEQ

Er du stærk på CTS, programmering og Niagara – og har du samtidig lyst til at udvikle dig mod projektledelse, kunderådgivning og forretningsudvikling?

Hos ALTEQ søger vi en CTS-projekttekniker, der trives med selvstændige opgaver og tekniske udfordringer, men som også har ambitioner om at spille en større rolle i fremtidens CTS-forretning. Derfor er denne stilling oplagt for dig, der på sigt ønsker at udvikle dig mod projektledelse, salg og udvikling af nye kunder og markeder.

En spændende rolle med udviklingsmuligheder

Du bliver en del af en specialiseret CTS-virksomhed med høj faglighed og korte beslutningsveje. I starten vil dit fokus primært være på de tekniske opgaver, men vi ser gerne, at du har interessen og lysten til gradvist at tage større ansvar inden for både kundeudvikling og forretningsudvikling.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den færdige projektleder – vi søger den rette person med potentialet til at blive det.

Dine opgaver som projektteknikker:

Som projekttekniker hos ALTEQ får du en alsidig hverdag med fokus på CTS, programmering og teknisk rådgivning. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Programmering og idriftsættelse af CTS-anlæg

  • Udvikling og optimering af tekniske løsninger

  • Arbejde med Tridium Niagara-platformen

  • Fejlfinding og teknisk sparring med kunder og kollegaer

  • Deltagelse i projektering og projektgennemførelse

  • Kundemøder og teknisk rådgivning

  • På sigt deltagelse i salgsmøder og udvikling af nye kunderelationer

Det får du hos ALTEQ 

Hos ALTEQ får du stor frihed til at planlægge din egen hverdag. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde, men vi værdsætter også det faglige og sociale fællesskab på kontoret, hvor vi sparrer med hinanden og udvikler os sammen.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og pensionsordning, og gode ansættelsesvilkår

  • Stor indflydelse på egen rolle og udvikling

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling – herunder på sigt projektledelse og forretningsudvikling

  • En arbejdsplads præget af høj faglighed, ordentlighed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Stor indflydelse på egen rolle i en virksomhed i vækst

Om dig som vores nye kollega:

Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund og erfaring med CTS-løsninger. Du trives med ansvar, arbejder struktureret og har lyst til løbende at udvikle dig. Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har solid programmeringserfaring

  • Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund fx som elektriker eller el-installatør og har solid erfaring med CTS og el-tekniske løsninger.

  • Har indgående kendskab til Tridium Niagara (krav)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har en struktureret tilgang og følger opgaver til dørs

  • Trives i dialogen med både kunder og kollegaer

  • Har interesse for eller lyst til at udvikle dig inden for salg, kunderelationer og forretningsudvikling

Om ALTEQ

ALTEQ er en specialiseret installations- og CTS-virksomhed i udvikling med base i Roskilde. Her er der korte beslutningsveje, tæt samarbejde og en ledelse, der er nærværende i hverdagen. Virksomheden er kendetegnet ved høj faglighed, stærke kunderelationer og en kultur, hvor ambitioner og menneskeligt overskud går hånd i hånd.

Om FLD
FLD er medejer af ALTEQ og består samlet set af ca. 270 medarbejdere med stærke kompetencer indenfor el, VVS, CTS, energi, teknik og service. For dig betyder det, at du bliver en del af en større organisation i ryggen med stærke kompetencer til rådighed på tværs af de to virksomheder.

Er du vores nye projektteknikker hos ALTEQ?

Hvis du kan se dig selv som vores nye projektteknikker hos ALTEQ i Roskilde, så tøv ikke med at kontakte os. Send din ansøgning og CV til direktør hos ALTEQ, Dennis Holmeskov Hansen på mail: dhh@alteq.dk. Ansættelse hurtigst muligt, men vi venter også gerne på den helt rette.

Læs også

VVS-servicemontør med blikerfaring søges til opgaver på Midtsjælland

Vægter du en god arbejdsplads, hvor der er fokus på trivsel og tryghed i hverdagen? Så bliv VVS-servicemontør hos FLD i Haslev. For den rette profil vil der være tale om en forventet mangeårig ansættelse med egne faste kunder i lokalområdet. Du skal have erfaring med blikarbejde.

Læs mere

title: betterpeople A/S is recruiting on behalf of CSIS Security Group for an Account Manager Team Lead.
description:
Account Manager Team Lead, CSIS Security Group
Would you like to help drive growth in one of the Nordic region’s leading cybersecurity companies while playing a key role in the development of an ambitious sales team? This is an opportunity to combine strong commercial responsibility with influence, autonomy, and a meaningful role in the continued growth and development of the business.

CSIS Security Group 
CSIS is a leading cybersecurity specialist with a strong Nordic foundation and an international reach. The company continues to grow at a pace that exceeds the market year after year, helping organisations prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats in a world where security has never been more critical. 

Since its establishment in 2001, CSIS has built a strong market position through deep expertise, uncompromising quality, and close customer relationships. Today, the company serves as a trusted advisor to both private and public sector organisations seeking specialist cybersecurity expertise. 

The culture is defined by ambition, collaboration, and a strong belief that the best results are achieved together. People work closely across the organisation, support one another, and share both successes and challenges. At the same time, there is a high degree of autonomy, short decision-making processes, and plenty of opportunities to make a meaningful impact. 

Based at CSIS’ headquarters in Copenhagen, this role offers the opportunity to work alongside some of the industry’s leading specialists in an ambitious and fast-growing organisation. 

The Role as Account Manager Team Lead 
This is not a traditional leadership position. You will remain actively involved in sales, managing your own customers, sales budget, and growth targets, while also playing a central role in the development of the sales team through coaching, coordination, and day-to-day leadership. 

Working closely with the sales leadership team, you will help shape the direction and development of the function during an exciting period of growth. Acting as the link between sales leadership and the team, you will lead from the front, contribute commercial insight, support colleagues in customer and business development activities, and help drive both individual and team performance. As the organisation continues to expand, the scope of the role is expected to evolve accordingly, creating opportunities for increased leadership responsibility over time. 

The role offers a unique opportunity to combine significant commercial impact with a broader responsibility for people, collaboration, and results. You will engage with organisations that can no longer rest assured that traditional security measures are sufficient and increasingly rely on trusted advisors to help strengthen their overall security posture. 

You bring 
You are a commercially driven professional with experience from cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, or a related technology environment. Building strong customer relationships, identifying business opportunities, and delivering results comes naturally to you. 

The role is ideal for someone ready to combine sales excellence with a broader responsibility for people and team development. You create energy and momentum around you, naturally build trust, and are recognised as a valued sparring partner by both customers and colleagues. 

You have a proven track record in complex B2B sales and are comfortable navigating longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers. You work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, take ownership of your responsibilities, and thrive in an environment where collaboration and high performance go hand in hand. 

Why Join CSIS? 
This is a unique opportunity to step into a leadership role within a company characterised by strong growth, ambitious goals, and a willingness to invest in both people and business development. 

You will join an organisation operating in a market with growing demand and increasing strategic importance, working alongside some of the industry's most skilled specialists while representing a strong brand in the cybersecurity sector. 

For the right candidate, this is a rare opportunity to combine continued commercial success with genuine influence on the development of an ambitious sales team and the next phase of CSIS’ growth journey. 

The Recruitment Process is Managed by betterpeople A/S
 As the position is to be filled as soon as possible, applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, we are willing to wait for the right candidate. 

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Sine Fæste at sfm@betterpeople.dk. All applications and enquiries will be treated with complete confidentiality and discretion. 

In accordance with data protection regulations, applications are accepted only via the application link on our website. If you experience difficulties submitting your application, please do not hesitate to contact us. 

Please note that our advertisements are automatically and continuously renewed on job portals until the position has been filled. A renewed advertisement should therefore not be interpreted as a reposting of the position, even if it may appear so.

title: Pædagog søges til Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard
description:
Vil du være en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor nærvær, relationer og udvikling er vigtigere end hurtige løsninger?

Hos Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard søger vi en engageret pædagog, som har lyst til at gøre en reel forskel for børn og unge, der har brug for stabile voksne, tydelige rammer og et hjem, hvor de kan udvikle sig.

Hos os er et job ikke bare et arbejde – det er en mulighed for at blive en betydningsfuld voksen i et barns liv.

Hvem er vi?

Boller Skov & Lindved Vestergaard er et socialpædagogisk døgntilbud for børn og unge med blandt andet omsorgssvigt, tilknytningsforstyrrelser, ADHD, udviklingsvanskeligheder og sociale eller følelsesmæssige udfordringer.

Vi arbejder ud fra en relationel, anerkendende og mentaliserende tilgang, hvor vi tror på, at:

  • Alle børn har udviklingspotentiale.

  • Tætte relationer skaber de største forandringer.

  • Diagnoser aldrig må definere barnets muligheder.

  • Udvikling skabes gennem engagement, struktur, omsorg og høj faglighed.

Vores pædagogiske fundament bygger blandt andet på:

  • AMA – Anerkend, Mentaliser, Ager

  • Growth Mindset

  • SMART-mål og systematisk dokumentation

  • En helhedsorienteret forståelse af det enkelte barn

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor du blandt andet skal:

  • skabe trygge og udviklende relationer til børn og unge

  • understøtte struktur og trivsel i hverdagen

  • planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter

  • samarbejde med familier, skoler, kommuner og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • dokumentere udvikling og deltage aktivt i statusarbejde og evaluering

  • indgå i døgnets forskellige vagter, herunder aften- og weekendvagter.

Vi søger dig, som

  • er uddannet pædagog

  • trives med ansvar og kan bevare roen i komplekse situationer

  • arbejder anerkendende, nysgerrigt og mentaliserende

  • kan skabe tydelige rammer med varme og nærvær

  • er fagligt ambitiøs og ønsker løbende udvikling

  • ser samarbejde som en styrke og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

  • har kørekort (kategori B).

Erfaring fra socialområdet er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lysten, engagementet og de personlige kompetencer til at gøre en forskel.

Hos os får du

  • en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold

  • grundig introduktion og mentorforløb

  • løbende supervision og sparring

  • gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og kompetenceudvikling

  • stor indflydelse på den pædagogiske praksis

  • engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden

  • en arbejdsplads med humor, nærvær og høje ambitioner på børnenes vegne.

Vi tror på relationer

Børnene bor ofte hos os gennem en stor del af deres barndom. Derfor tror vi på, at de voksne omkring dem skal være autentiske, engagerede og stabile. Vi ser os selv som en del af hinandens livshistorier, og vi gør os umage – hver eneste dag.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i den tilgang, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er på fuld tid og ønskes besat hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Karen Brostrøm på 53436322

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til info@bollerskov.dk.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

What We Offer

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard

Hvem er vi?

Massage Experterne er en professionel massageklinik med fokus på kvalitet, grundighed og resultater.

Vores klienter kommer blandt andet med muskelspændinger, sportsskader, smerter og stressrelaterede gener. Vi lægger vægt på et roligt og tillidsfuldt behandlingsmiljø, hvor klienterne føler sig i trygge og kompetente hænder.

job@massageexperterne.dk

Massage Therapist Wanted for a Permanent Full-Time Position in Frederiksberg – Maximum 30 Hours per Week

Are you passionate about making a real difference in people’s lives through massage?

Massage Experterne is a busy clinic, and we are currently looking for two skilled and dedicated massage therapists to join our team in Frederiksberg.

We offer proper employment conditions, a solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay, and a working week designed with an understanding of how physically demanding massage therapy can be. For this reason, a full-time position with us consists of no more than 30 hours per week.

You will enjoy a busy working environment with plenty of clients, supportive colleagues and opportunities for continuous professional development.

About the Position

You will primarily treat private clients at our clinic in Frederiksberg. We also work with several companies where we provide on-site corporate massage.

Treatments mainly consist of therapeutic and deep-tissue massage, focusing on areas such as:

  • Muscle tension and pain

  • Neck, shoulder and back problems

  • Sports injuries and overuse injuries

  • Stress-related tension

  • Improved mobility and well-being

The clinic will be your permanent base, although the position may also include occasional corporate massage shifts.

What We Offer

  • A permanent full-time position of no more than 30 hours per week

  • A solid fixed base salary plus treatment-based pay

  • An employment contract and proper working conditions

  • A busy, well-run clinic with plenty of clients

  • Financial security and stable employment

  • Ongoing professional support from skilled and experienced colleagues

  • Workshops, courses and opportunities for professional development

  • Social events and a strong sense of teamwork

  • A workplace focused on quality, results and employee well-being

Who We Are Looking For

  • You are a qualified massage therapist or physiotherapist

  • You have experience with therapeutic or deep-tissue massage

  • You are able to provide treatments to a high professional standard

  • You are professional, welcoming and comfortable communicating with clients

  • You are reliable and able to work independently and in a structured manner

  • You speak either Danish or English to a good standard

It is an advantage if you have completed at least 250 hours of massage training or are RAB registered, but this is not a requirement. If you have completed fewer training hours but possess strong practical skills and relevant experience, we would still be very pleased to hear from you.

Who Are We?

Massage Experterne is a professional massage clinic focused on quality, thoroughness and results.

Our clients visit us with issues including muscle tension, sports injuries, pain and stress-related discomfort. We prioritise creating a calm and trusting treatment environment where clients feel safe and in capable hands.

As a therapist, you will become part of a close-knit team where we support one another and prioritise both professional development and a positive working environment.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

job@massageexperterne.dk

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

title: Electrical Engineer - High Voltage; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
description:
Are you searching for a place to work where you can truly make a difference and have a leading role in our continued expansion? A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593
  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?

Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk

https://mmm-rc.dk/

No smoking.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Waitress
description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation
