title: SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d) (IT-Manager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Betrieb, Administration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der LAN- und WLAN-Infrastruktur auf Basis von Cisco Meraki
- Konfiguration und Optimierung von Netzwerkkomponenten, einschließlich VLANs, Inter-VLAN-Routing und standortübergreifender Netzwerkanbindungen
- Weiterentwicklung der WLAN-Sicherheitsarchitektur durch den Einsatz von 802.1X, RADIUS-Authentifizierung sowie zertifikatsbasierten Verfahren (EAP-TLS)

- Unterstützung bei der Analyse und Bearbeitung von Sicherheitsvorfällen sowie Eskalationen im Rahmen von Incident-Response-Prozessen
- Erstellung und Pflege von Betriebsdokumentationen, Runbooks, Standard Changes und technischen Konzepten
- Unterstützung bei der Härtung von Netzwerk- und Sicherheitsinfrastrukturen sowie der Einführung neuer Security-Standards

Ihr Profil:

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Netzwerk- und IT-Security-Administration
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen LAN, WLAN, VLANs, Routing und Netzwerkarchitekturen, idealerweise mit Cisco Meraki
- Erfahrung im Betrieb von Firewalls und Next-Generation-Firewall-Lösungen (z. B. SonicWall oder vergleichbare Systeme)
- Gute Kenntnisse in 802.1X, RADIUS/NPS sowie zertifikatsbasierten Authentifizierungsverfahren (EAP-TLS)
- Erfahrung mit VPN-, Zero-Trust- und Remote-Access-Lösungen, beispielsweise Azure VPN Gateway, SonicWall oder Microsoft Entra Private Access
- Kenntnisse im Betrieb von Security-Lösungen wie EDR/NDR sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Security Operations Centern
- Erfahrung im Bereich Incident Response und Security Incident Management
- Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in einem 24/7-Betriebsumfeld
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

title: SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d) (IT-Manager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

As part of the Arvato Group, we are seeking new team members for ATC Computer Transport & Logistics GmbH**, Hessenring 15L in 64546 Mörfelden-Walldorf. title: Senior Expert Corporate Lean Management (m/f/d) (Lean-Manager/in)
description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As a Senior Expert Corporate Production Management (m/f/d) at Exyte, you will play a key role in implementing and further developing our Lean philosophy across international projects.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Implementing Lean Design and Lean Construction methods across all project phases using PPM (Project Production Management), LPS (Last Planner System), and Exyte standard software.
- Training project team members and key users on Lean Construction methods, tools, and software.
- Continuously improving and optimizing standardized Lean tools and methods in close collaboration with stakeholders.
- Driving the transformation and development of high-performance teams by inspiring enthusiasm for Lean principles and production control.
- Acting as the first point of contact for all Lean Design and Construction-related topics within projects.

Show your expertise

- A degree in engineering or project management.
- Extensive expertise in Lean principles.
- 10+ years experience in construction projects and the implementation of Lean project delivery methodologies.
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to facilitate workshops and trainings.
- A hands-on mentality and the motivation to drive sustainable improvements.
- Readiness to undertake regular weekly travel to our project sites for up to five days per week to support and train teams in the implementation of Lean principles and production control.
- Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken).

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues.
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks.
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team.
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working.
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor.
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany.

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

title: Mitarbeiter (w/m/d) Kundenservice / 1249 (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Aufgabenbereich

- Als freundlicher und kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bearbeitest du Anfragen zu unseren Hosting-Produkten (Fokus liegt hier auf Domains) per Telefon und E-Mail.
- Mithilfe moderner Technik stellst du eine qualitativ hochwertige Kundenerfahrung sicher.
- Als Customer Champion erkennst du Potenziale, um unsere Kunden bedarfsgerecht und individuell zu beraten und passenden Leistungen anzubieten.
- Du arbeitest mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Team, um neue Ideen zu entwickeln und unseren Kundenservice weiter zu verbessern.
- Mit internen Schulungen wirst du zum Profi in der Kundenkommunikation und unserer Produktpalette.

Qualifikationen

- Du kommunizierst gern, egal ob per E-Mail oder per Telefon. Dabei mischst du Beratung und Vertrieb zu einer einzigartigen Kundenerfahrung.
- Ein schnelllebiger Arbeitsalltag bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe und du siehst jeden Kundenkontakt als Chance.
- Du begeisterst dich für Technik und bist bereit, dich in unsere Domain & Hosting-Produkte einzuarbeiten.
- Als Teamplayer bringst du unseren Kundenservice gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen voran.
- Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch und fühlst dich in Englisch sicher

Benefits

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit.
- An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
- Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
- Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
- Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
- Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
- Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

title: Environmental Test Technician (AIT) (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Luftfahrttechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
description:
Akkodis is a global digital engineering consulting company that brings together technology and talent to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 40,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies - from AI and data analytics to cloud, edge computing, automation and cybersecurity.

Kundendetails

We are currently seeking a talented professional to join our team in Munich for an exciting project with one of our clients in the aerospace industry.

Stellenbeschreibung

- Execute thermal-vacuum and thermal cycling tests on spaceflight hardware
- Develop and implement environmental test procedures in collaboration with Test Leads
- Monitor, control and evaluate environmental test campaigns
- Maintain thermal-vacuum chambers and associated test equipment
- Define test processes and environmental test facility configurations
- Support the specification of environmental test equipment in collaboration with engineering teams
- Analyze test results and prepare technical reports
- Create and maintain procedures, work instructions and operational standards

Profil

- 3-5 years of experience in AIT, environmental testing or laboratory operations, preferably in the aerospace industry
- Experience with thermal cycling, thermal-vacuum testing and precision metrology
- Knowledge of space standards, environmental test setups and spacecraft qualification testing
- Proven ability to develop, execute and report environmental test campaigns
- Hands-on experience with metrology equipment such as CMMs and laser trackers
- Strong understanding of spaceflight hardware and environmental test requirements
- Willingness to work shifts and occasional weekends
- Fluent in English; German is an advantage

Das Angebot

- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- A wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team and sports events
- Global network
- Attractive employee referral program

Benefits may vary depending on the position and location. An overview of our benefits can be found on our website under the "Careers and Benefits" section.

title: Immobilienmanagement und soziale Wohnraumversorgung (Immobilienassistent/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Soziale Arbeit; Sozialpädagogik

Stellenbeschreibung:
Werden Sie Teil des Verbundes der Behrens-Stiftung und wirken Sie an einer zeitgemäßen Wohnungslosenhilfe in Hamburg mit. Die Behrens-Stiftung ist über ihre Tochtergesellschaft Neue Wohnung gGmbH als anerkannter Träger der Wohnungslosenhilfe aktiv. Die Neue Wohnung betreibt in den Hamburger Stadteilen Altona, Barmbek, Wilhelmsburg, Eimsbüttel und Eilbek seit vielen Jahren Wohnprojekte für obdachlose Menschen. Einzelunterbringung, kleine Projektgrößen, Unterstützung bei der Wohnraumsuche und die Begleitung unserer Bewohner*innen während der ersten Zeit in der eigenen Wohnung sind Kennzeichen unserer Arbeit. Die Versorgung und Vermittlung in Wohnraum spielen dabei eine entscheidende Rolle. Daher suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Teams eine Fachkraft für

Immobilienmanagement und soziale Wohnraumversorgung (m/w/d)

in Vollzeit

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Sie akquirieren Wohnungen für obdachlose Menschen auf dem Wohnungsmarkt.
- Sie suchen nach Immobilien und Grundstücken, die für eine soziale Wohnraumversorgung geeignet sind.
- Sie pflegen Kontakte zu Wohnungsunternehmen mit dem Ziel, weitere Wohnungen zu erhalten.
- Sie arbeiten mit den Vermieter*innen von der Besichtigung über die Anmietung bis zur Schlüsselübergabe eng zusammen und gewährleisten eine unmittelbare Ansprechbarkeit für die Vermieter*innen.
- Sie begleiten die Mieter*innen im gesamten Anmietungsverfahren und unterstützen bei Fragen zu den Wohn- und Mietverhältnissen.
- Sie unterstützen und koordinieren bei Bedarf die Zusammenarbeit der Mieter*innen mit der Sozialarbeit, Haustechnik, Hausverwaltung und externen Dienstleistern vor, während und nach dem Anmietungsprozess.
- Sie wirken zielorientiert und verlässlich in einem innovativen multiprofessionellen Team mit.

Ihr Profil:

- Ausbildung bzw. Studium in der Immobilienwirtschaft und/oder Studium der Sozialarbeit/Sozialpädagogik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
- Erfahrungen in der Zusammenarbeit mit der lokalen Wohnungswirtschaft
- Idealerweise Erfahrungen in der Wohnraumvermittlung und Kenntnisse über die Abläufe von Wohnungsvermietungen an Personen mit Zugangsschwierigkeiten zum Wohnungsmarkt
- Begeisterung für und Interesse an der Mitgestaltung einer innovativen Wohnraumversorgung von wohnungslosen Menschen
- Gepflegtes und verbindliches persönliches Auftreten sowie hohe soziale Kompetenz
- Große zeitliche Flexibilität sowie Kommunikationsbereitschaft und -fähigkeit

Wir bieten:

- Die Mitwirkung und -gestaltung eines innovativen Angebots in der Wohnungslosenarbeit in einem engagierten Team
- Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 39 Stunden bei attraktiver Vergütung auf Basis der Arbeitsvertragsrichtlinien der Diakonie Deutschland (AVR DD)
- Eine zusätzliche betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns selbstverständlich und mobiles Arbeiten bieten wir natürlich auch an
- 31 Urlaubstage sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester
- Auch die Nutzung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs möchten wir unterstützen und bezuschussen Ihr Deutschlandticket
- Unser besonderer Benefit für Sie: Wir finanzieren Ihnen eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung, mit der Sie Zugang zu einer optimalen gesundheitlichen Versorgung erhalten.

Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der Neuen Wohnung gemeinnützige Wohnungslosenhilfe GmbH.

- bist Du visionärer Impulsgeber (m/w/d), mutiger und kreativer Initiator (m/w/d) sowie konsequenter Umsetzer (m/w/d) strategischer Maßnahmen und Initiativen
- bist Du aktiv in der Marktbeobachtung und nimmst Marktimpulse für die GD-Gruppe proaktiv auf; hierfür blickst Du über den Tellerrand und nutzt Innovationen und neue Ansätze zur Steigerung der Profitabilität und der Verbesserung des Kundenerlebens auch aus versicherungsfremden Branchen
- kannst Du ein „Big Picture“ konzipieren, daraus Ideen ableiten sowie eigenverantwortlich eine Roadmap und Maßnahmenvorschläge zur Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsmodelle Exclusive, Direct und Broker kreieren
- verstärkst Du die strategische Governance der GD-Gruppe, indem Du als Koordinator, Vorbereiter und Treiber (m/w/d) der strategischen Diskussionen in Zusammenarbeit mit allen beteiligten Bereichen fungierst, die Zulieferung zu unterschiedlichen Gremien und Berichten übernimmst und verantwortliche Rollen bei der Umsetzung von strategisch wichtigen Initiativen und Vorhaben einnimmst

Das wünschen wir uns

- Du hast den Kopf eines Strategen (m/w/d) und das Herz eines Umsetzers (m/w/d) mit Zug zum Ziel; Du kannst disruptive Visionen vermitteln und Menschen mitnehmen; darüber hinaus besitzt Du ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium vorzugsweise der Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Bank / Versicherungslehre oder Unternehmensführung/-entwicklung und verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement; wir freuen uns, wenn Du Erfahrung aus der Strategieentwicklung, dem Business Development oder dem Finanz- und Unternehmensberatungs-Umfeld mitbringst
- Du begeisterst Dich für unsere Kunden und bist bereit, unsere Kunden- und Vertriebspartnererlebnisse auf ein neues Level zu heben; dabei bist Du mit Leib und Seele Entrepreneur (m/w/d) im Unternehmen und bringst echte „Hands-On-Mentalität“ mit

- Du hast starke Kommunikations-Skills über alle Hierarchieebenen sowie die Fähigkeit, Netzwerke aufzubauen und deren Mehrwerte zu heben; Du beherrscht das "Storytelling" und zeichnest dich durch die Fähigkeit aus, komplexe Sachverhalte zu strukturieren und verständlich zu vermitteln; darüber hinaus bist Du gegenüber Veränderungen stets positiv eingestellt und hast eine Affinität für detaillierte Geschäftsabläufe und neue Technologien
- Du hast eine Vorliebe für Zahlen und Daten, verfügst über ausgeprägte logische und quantitative Analysefähigkeit, und kannst dich für den Versicherungsmarkt und deren Akteure begeistern; Du behältst stets ein Ohr am Markt und bist up-to-date in Bezug auf Nachrichtenlage und Marktentwicklung
- Neben einem hohen Maß an Motivation, Eigeninitiative und Teamfähigkeit, arbeitest Du selbstständig, strukturiert sowie ergebnisorientiert und hast die Fähigkeit, unter Druck und mit engen Fristen zu arbeiten; Methodenkenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse, Geschäftsprozessoptimierung entlang von Customer Journeys, klassischem und agilem Projektmanagement, etc. sind dabei von Vorteil

title: Business Controller (f/m/d) (Vertriebscontroller/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Business Controller (f/m/d) within the TI CP Business Controlling team, you serve as a trusted advisor to the Compression Service Region Europe & Africa, supporting a business spanning more than 35 countries. Working closely with regional leadership, finance teams, and operational stakeholders, you provide transparency on financial performance, drive forecasting and budgeting processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across a dynamic and diverse business environment.

Beyond core business controlling, you contribute to key strategic initiatives, including Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), sustainability reporting, central function controlling, and high-impact transformation projects. By combining financial expertise with business acumen and cross-functional collaboration, you help drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation across the region.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Acting as the primary Finance Business Partner for the Compression Service Europe & Africa management team, providing financial transparency and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
* Leading regional forecasting, budgeting, financial performance reviews, and financial planning & analysis activities across a network of more than 35 countries while identifying risks and opportunities
* Strengthening the Enterprise Risk Management framework and partnering with sustainability teams to support ESG initiatives, including EU Taxonomy reporting and compliance requirements
* Providing financial governance and controlling support for central functions, ensuring cost transparency, effective resource allocation, and sound financial governance
* Leading and supporting strategic projects and transformation initiatives, delivering financial insights, business case analyses, and value-creating recommendations
* Promoting process harmonization, digitalization, and automation to improve reporting quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making capabilities

What You Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or other advanced degree is considered an advantage
* Proven experience in controlling, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), business partnering, or finance leadership within an international environment
* Strong expertise in forecasting, budgeting, financial reporting, variance analysis, performance management, and financial governance, ideally complemented by knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management, ESG, or sustainability reporting
* Proven analytical and strategic capabilities with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations and influence management decisions
* Hands-on experience with SAP, financial planning systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office, combined with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills in multicultural organizations
* Fluent English skills; additional language skills are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

title: Data Analyst - focus on Source-to-Pay (m/w/d) (Data-Analyst/in)
description:
Are you passionate about transforming data into powerful insights and driving smarter business decisions?

KWS Berlin GmbH is looking for a Data Analyst with focus on Source-to-Pay (m/w/d) who is keen on translating business requirements into analytics solutions and operating and optimizing data pipelines with strong governance and Master Data standards. This position is unlimited and available on a full-time basis (38 hours/week) in Berlin.

Your Responsibilities:

- Translate business requirements into analytics solutions and collaborate across the full project lifecycle.
- Operate and optimize data pipelines (ERP, S2P suite, AP, vendor master) with strong governance and master data management standards.
- Perform diagnostic and predictive analyses to identify value levers (e.g., price/volume variance, payment term optimization).
- Partner with cross-functional teams to define KPI standards, maintain data dictionaries, and ensure a single source of truth.
- Support process mining and advanced analytics use cases (e.g., Celonis) to uncover inefficiencies.
- Monitor and manage the Source-to-Pay (S2P) analytics landscape for stability, scalability, and compliance.
- Drive adoption and change management for analytics solutions across S2P.
- Build functional analytics capabilities within the S2P organization.

Your profile:

- Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
- Proven experience in Procurement, Finance, Source-to-Pay (S2P), or Spend Analytics environments.
- Experience with Master Data Management (MDM), data governance frameworks, and data quality monitoring.
- Solid understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and familiarity with SAP S/4HANA.
- Experience working with large datasets and translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.
- Desirable experience in Power Apps, Power Automate and SAP Ariba.
- Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, SAP SAC, Datasphere) and process mining (Celonis).
- Strong SQL skills; Python or R is a plus.
- Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and proactive approach.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Our offer:

- We are an international team of open-minded people with diverse and cross-functional experience;
- Interesting and challenging tasks and projects;
- As a family business, we are guided by the values of closeness, reliability, vision and independence; this culture is lived in practice and ensures an open and friendly working atmosphere from day one;
- The best of both worlds: KWS Berlin combines the security of a large, stable company with the passion of a start-up;
- Our location in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg is very modern; directly opposite the underground station Bülowstraße and with secured car & bicycle parking spaces;
- We offer 30d holidays, flexible working hours, holiday and Christmas bonuses, company pension scheme, JobRad and/or Jobticket;
- True to our motto "Make yourself grow", we support the professional and personal development of our employees.

We look forward to receiving your online application via our application system SuccessFactors! Please use the "Apply" function in the online advertisement.

- Prozessführung vor staatlichen Gerichten, Schiedsgerichten (DIS) und Adjudikation – taktisch, pointiert, durchsetzungsstark

- Strategisches Urteilsvermögen & souveräner Umgang mit Bauverantwortlichen, Projektsteuernden, Planenden und ausführenden Unternehmen
- „See it – Own it – Fix it“ ist für Sie Haltung, nicht Schlagwort
- Authentische Persönlichkeit, die Mandanten und Kolleg:innen gleichermaßen begeistert

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- - Exzellenz mit Auszeichnung: Luther ist JUVE-Kanzlei des Jahres für Vergaberecht 2023; JUVE-Kanzlei des Jahres für Regulierung 2024
- Klare Entwicklungswege: Individuell zugeschnittener Kompetenz-Plan, Luther.academy, Fachanwaltsförderung „Bau- und Architektenrecht“, Mentoring
- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Teilzeitoptionen, Elternzeit-Support, Familienservice
- Unternehmerisches Spielfeld: Beteiligung an Akquise, LegalTech-Piloten, Knowledge-Building – Ihre Ideen zählen
- Teamkultur und Establishment: Standortübergreifendes Construction-Cluster, offener Austausch, gemeinsame Erfolge
- Top-Adresse & Tools: Modernste Infrastruktur, Research-Plattformen, Litigation-Support – alles, was Sie für Best-in-Class-Arbeit benötigen
- Benefits & Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Mobilitätszuschuss, Corporate Benefits, JobRad sowie ein bezuschusstes Fitnessangebot

title: Senior Manager Construction (m/w/d) (Bauleiter/in)
employer: NTT Global Data Centers EMEA GmbH
description:
Ihre Rolle auf einen Blick

Als Senior Director - Construction (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Hyperscale-Rechenzentrums-Campi sowie geschäftskritischen Infrastrukturprojekten. In Ihrer Funktion als leitende Führungskraft am Standort steuern Sie mehrere parallel laufende Projekte und Bauphasen und stellen höchste Standards hinsichtlich Arbeitssicherheit, Qualität, Termin- und Budgeteinhaltung, Inbetriebnahme, Betriebsbereitschaft sowie Stakeholder-Management sicher.

Die Position ist hauptsächlich an unserem Standort FRA6 angesiedelt. Darüber hinaus besteht die Möglichkeit, bei Bedarf weitere Standorte im Raum Frankfurt zu unterstützen. Obwohl die Rolle überwiegend vor Ort ausgeübt wird, ist gelegentliches mobiles Arbeiten möglich, sofern dies mit den operativen und projektbezogenen Anforderungen vereinbar ist.

Bitte reichen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf in englischer Sprache ein.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Führung und Weiterentwicklung interdisziplinärer Teams in den Bereichen Bau, Projektmanagement, Planung, Projektsteuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Lieferantenmanagement
- Strategische Gesamtverantwortung für die erfolgreiche Realisierung von Hyperscale-Rechenzentrums-Campi und zugehöriger Infrastruktur
- Steuerung sämtlicher Bauaktivitäten, einschließlich Tief- und Hochbau, Gebäudehülle und Rohbau, technischer Gebäudeausrüstung (MEP), Innenausbau, Versorgungseinrichtungen und externer Infrastruktur
- Förderung einer ausgeprägten Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltkultur unter Einhaltung aller Unternehmensstandards sowie relevanten gesetzlichen Vorgaben
- Verantwortung für Terminplanung, Budgetkontrolle, Qualitätsmanagement, Risikomanagement, Änderungsmanagement sowie Berichterstattung an das Senior Management
- Koordination von Generalunternehmern, Spezialsubunternehmern, OFCI-Lieferanten, Versorgungsunternehmen, Behörden und weiteren wesentlichen Stakeholdern
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Commissioning, Commercial und HSE über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg
- Sicherstellung von Standardisierung, Konsistenz und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung innerhalb aller Campus-Realisierungsaktivitäten
- Überwachung der Leistung von Auftragnehmern, Personalplanung, Produktivität und termingerechter Erreichung von Meilensteinen
- Steuerung von Inbetriebnahmen, integrierten Systemtests sowie phasenweisen Übergaben zur Sicherstellung der Betriebsbereitschaft

Ihr Profil

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen, Construction Management, Projektmanagement, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung beziehungsweise eine gleichwertige Kombination aus Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung
- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung von Bau- und Infrastrukturprojekten, davon mindestens 10 Jahre in geschäftskritischen Branchen wie Rechenzentren, Industrie- oder Infrastrukturprojekten
- Nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Umsetzung großvolumiger Campusentwicklungen oder geschäftskritischer Projekte, idealerweise mit einer kritischen Kapazität von mehr als 100 MW
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bauprojektmanagement, Projektcontrolling, Terminplanung, Beschaffung, Vertragsmanagement und Inbetriebnahme
- Erfahrung in der Projektabwicklung nach Design & Build-, EPC-, Management Contracting- und/oder klassischen Vergabemodellen
- Gute Kenntnisse gängiger Vertragswerke, insbesondere FIDIC und vergleichbarer Vertragsstandards
- Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, komplexe Stakeholder-Beziehungen im Umfeld von Kunden, Auftragnehmern, Lieferanten und Behörden erfolgreich zu managen
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs-, Organisations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Sicherer Umgang mit Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint sowie Projekt-Reporting-Tools
- Fähigkeit zur erfolgreichen Zusammenarbeit in internationalen und multikulturellen Teams
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wer wir sind

Als drittgrößter Betreiber von Rechenzentren weltweit betreiben wir mehr als 150 Rechenzentren in über 20 Ländern und Regionen. Wir wissen, dass jedes Unternehmen, unabhängig von seiner Größe, individuelle Anforderungen und Ziele hat. Mit unserer lokalen und globalen Rechenzentrumsexpertise sowie einer vernetzten Plattform aus KI-fähigen Rechenzentren entwickeln wir Lösungen, die es unseren Kunden ermöglichen, ihre digitalen Geschäftsmodelle jederzeit und überall nahtlos zu skalieren.

title: SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d) (IT-Manager/in)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

title: Kernel/Hypervisor Engineer, AWS, EC2 Live Migration (Informatiker/in)
employer: Amazon Web Services Developmen t Center Germany GmbH
description:
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) is a fast-growing business that provides cost effective easy-to-use cloud computing resources to businesses of all sizes around the world. At the Amazon Development Center in Dresden, Germany, we develop and operate Live Migration. This technology enables seamless migration of EC2 instances between physical hosts, helping our customers maintain their applications' availability and resilience.

Are you interested in working where low level programming and large-scale distributed services meet? Are you curious and willing to dive deep to innovate across the various layers that make up EC2? Do you see ambiguous decisions a challenge rather than an obstacle? If so, join our team of highly skilled developers, help us raise the bar to give our customers the best experience a cloud can offer!

We are looking for a highly motivated low level Software Development Engineer to join our EC2 Live Migration team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing software at the kernel and hypervisor level. In this role, you will work with a team of experienced engineers to build, maintain, and operate our server-side technology that enables Live Migration in EC2. The role involves working with low-level technologies and pushing the limits of what is possible in cloud computing.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities

- Design and develop low-level software for Live Migration in EC2 (mainly in C).
- Write high-quality code that is reliable, scalable, and efficient.
- Work closely with multiple teams to identify, debug, and resolve issues in a timely manner.
- Conduct testing and debugging of software releases.
- Actively participate in code reviews and provide feedback to team members.
- Collaborate with other teams to ensure seamless integration of new features.
- Keep up-to-date with emerging trends and technologies in cloud computing.

A day in the life
At Amazon, we highly value Ownership. As a Software Development Engineer, you will take responsibility for designing, implementing, and delivering projects in a timely manner. Given our strategic position, execution requires daily collaboration with peers at various sites around the world. Being a team player is a must! We care about your career growth. We will find and assign you projects that fit your experience and help you grow your career.

We do not split development and operations. As part of this role, you will be part of an on-call rotation. We relentlessly work to deliver the best quality software to avoid getting paged during our off hours, and expect you to do the same.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in computer architecture
- Strong programming skills in C.
- Experience developing code for the Linux Kernel and/or hypervisors. E.g. device drivers, working with ISR, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: GD Machine Technician
description:

You'll be responsible for the setup, operation, and maintenance of our G.D (Coesia Group, Bologna) pouch-filling line, ensuring efficient, high-quality production with minimal downtime. This is a hands-on technical role central to our manufacturing operation.

•    Ability to read technical manuals and machine documentation
•    Willingness to work shifts as required by production schedule

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
