AMS Diagnostics is recruiting a senior Neurophysiologist to run its outpatient neurophysiology lab in Cork City, Ireland. The service is providing Nerve Conduction Studies (NCS) to patients that are referred for this investigation. The company is planning on introducing Electroencephalograms (EEG’s) and Home Video Telemetry (HVT) EEG’s in the short future. The Neurophysiologist will work closely with the Consultant Neurophysiologist to advance knowledge in the field and improve patient outcomes. The Neurophysiologist will perform duties and responsibilities according to the philosophy of AMS Diagnostics, including excellent patient care and swift access to services for our referring physicians. Patient care, teamwork & customer service are key priorities in this role. Key Responsibilities Triage referrals received and discuss them with Consultant Clinical Neurophysiologist when required. Go through patient questionnaire & relevant history with the patient prior to performing the test. Thoroughly understands various disease states and factors that relate to them, various medication effects, clinical changes or complications to ensure high technical quality of the study performed. Performs high-quality nerve conduction studies & EEG’s autonomously and according to protocols. Produces a high-quality factual report for the Consultant Neurophysiologist to interpret and report on the studies performed. Includes notes on the study where relevant. Obtains standard recordings, utilises judgement to determine whether patient meets normal standards and reports significant changes to appropriate personnel. Performs calibration as required and ensures maintenance as appropriate. Able to troubleshoot minor equipment issues and escalate necessary Keep documentation in line with the clinic’s protocols Adhere to GDPR principles at all times Be confident in training and supervising new Physiologists/students in Neurophysiology studies carried out at the Diagnostic Centre. Open and willing to develop new applicable services within the organisation. During quiet periods be willing and able to perform other functions e.g. contact referred patients to make appointments. Show and explain to patients how to wear other at home diagnostic devices such as Holter /Sleep equipment. Qualifications: Possess the BSc in Clinical Measurement from Dublin Institute of Technology or from a recognised equivalent 3rd level institution. Minimum of 3 years post-graduation experience in Neurophysiology and in performing nerve conduction studies & EEG’s autonomously. High Proficiency in English (speaking & writing). What you will bring Relevant trade qualification, diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Mechanical Maintenance or a related discipline. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. This role requires participation in an on-call roster, including out-of-hours and weekend call-outs.

title: OBGYN Consultant opportunities at University Hospitals in Ireland
description:
Would you like a role with broad clinical exposure within both obstetrics and gynecology while gaining experience in an English-speaking healthcare system?

On behalf of university hospitals and established specialist environments in Ireland, we are recruiting OBGYN consultant for 6-12 month positions, with the possibility of extension.

This opportunity is well suited for specialists who would like to work broadly across both obstetrics and gynecology while gaining experience from modern hospital environments with high clinical activity and close multidisciplinary collaboration.

We are particularly interested in candidates with strong experience in general obstetrics and gynecology as well as broad surgical competence within gynecological procedures. For several of the positions, a minimum of three years of experience at consultant level is preferred.

Please note that you must hold medical authorisation and specialist certification from an EU/EEA country to be eligible for these roles.

About the position

As an OBGYN consultant, you will work with the assessment, treatment and follow-up of patients within both obstetrics and gynecology. The role combines outpatient care, surgical activity, inpatient management and assessment of acute presentations.

The positions involve close collaboration with midwives, anesthesiology staff, nurses and other medical specialties. Several of the hospitals are university-affiliated and have active specialist environments within research, teaching and clinical development.

Typical responsibilities

    Management and follow-up of pregnant and laboring patients
    Assessment and treatment of gynecological conditions
    Gynecological surgery and operative procedures
    Outpatient clinics and day surgery
    Evaluation and management of acute obstetric and gynecological presentations
    Participation in multidisciplinary collaboration and coordination of patient pathways
    Supervision and mentoring of resident doctors and other healthcare professionals
    Contributing to quality improvement, patient safety, and clinical development
    Participation in on-call duties where applicable

Surgical expertise and clinical areas

We are looking for candidates with broad gynecological surgical expertise, including:

    Total abdominal hysterectomy (TAH)
    Vaginal hysterectomy
    Pelvic floor and prolapse surgery
    Diagnostic and operative laparoscopy
    Operative hysteroscopy
    Outpatient gynecological procedures and ambulatory gynecology services

Experience in the following areas is also highly desirable:

    Transvaginal ultrasound for endometrial assessment
    Diagnostic hysteroscopy
    Operative hysteroscopy using MyoSure and TCRF resectoscope
    Colposcopy, preferably with BSCCP accreditation

We are looking for someone who

    Is a specialist in obstetrics and gynecology
    Holds EU/EEA medical authorization and specialist certification
    Has broad experience within general obstetrics and gynecology
    Has strong surgical experience in gynecological procedures
    Has experience providing ambulatory gynecology services
    Has excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
    Thrives in an international and multidisciplinary working environment
    Maintains high professional standards with strong focus on quality and patient safety

We offer

    Contract for 6-12 months, with the possibility of extension
    The opportunity to gain international experience in an English-speaking healthcare system
    Positions at established university hospitals and specialist environments within OBGYN
    Close follow-up and guidance throughout the entire recruitment process
    Assistance with registration, interviews and relocation
    The opportunity for a short visit to Ireland, ideally together with your partner or family, to get to know the hospital and the area before making a decision

Salary

Base salary depending on experience, typically around €233,000–€280,000 gross per year.

Why Ireland?

Working in Ireland gives you the opportunity to practice medicine in an English-speaking healthcare system while gaining valuable international experience. You will work in a collaborative clinical environment with modern facilities and a strong focus on patient care.

Beyond work, Ireland offers a high quality of life and a welcoming atmosphere. The country is known for its dramatic coastline, green landscapes and charming towns. Ireland also has a lively social culture, where local pubs often serve as gathering places for music, conversation and community.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the opportunities, possible locations and the next steps in the process. Feel free to contact us for an informal conversation.

title: Database and network professionals
description: Vuoi essere parte del cambiamento digitale e della trasformazione tecnologica? Hai esperienza in ambito ICT e vuoi lavorare su progetti innovativi? Potremmo avere l'opportunità giusta per te! Grafton ICT* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito AI, Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud, ERP & CRM, Sistemi e Infrastrutture, IMAC e Sviluppo. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative Per importante realtà specializzata in system integration, cybersecurity, cloud e trasformazione digitale per imprese e pubblica amministrazione, ricerchiamo un Network Engineer (Routing, switching, wan networking) Ruolo: per il potenziamento del nostro team cerchiamo un Network Engineer con esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture WAN Enterprise. La risorsa lavorerà direttamente presso il cliente, occupandosi della configurazione, implementazione e ottimizzazione delle reti, garantendo elevati standard di affidabilità e continuità operativa. Responsabilità: Presidierai l'infrastruttura di rete presso il cliente Configurerai e gestirai reti L2/L3 e infrastrutture WAN basate su MPLS (L2VPN/L3VPN) Gestirai protocolli di routing dinamico come OSPF e BGP Parteciperai a progetti di delivery, migrazione e attivazione di nuove sedi Effettuerai troubleshooting avanzato e attività di problem solving su infrastrutture Enterprise Collaborerai con il team IT del cliente e con i carrier di telecomunicazioni Contribuirai all'ottimizzazione delle performance e dell'affidabilità della rete Requisiti: 3-5 anni di esperienza come Network Engineer Esperienza su routing e switching L2/L3 Esperienza nella configurazione e gestione di reti MPL Conoscenza dei protocolli OSPF e BGP Esperienza nella gestione di infrastrutture WAN Enterprise Capacità di troubleshooting su reti complesse Possesso di almeno una certificazione networking attiva (Cisco CCNP o equivalente Juniper, Huawei o altri vendor) Requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza di soluzioni SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VMware Velocloud o equivalenti) Esperienza nella configurazione di firewall Fortinet, Cisco ASA o Palo Alto Esperienza in società di consulenza, System Integrator o Service Provider o PA Offerta Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato. Retribuzione prevista: La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35 e € 40 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. title: elettrotecnico
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per una realtà in forte crescita nel settore energie rinnovabili, efficientamento energetico e mobilità sostenibile, con sede a Napoli centro (comodamente raggiungibile con i mezzi pubblici), ricerchiamo un/una: PROGETTISTA ELETTRICO (inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato - livelli da Junior a Senior) La risorsa sarà inserita nell'Area Ingegneria, in un team di 4 persone, e si occuperà dello sviluppo di progetti elettrici di impianti energetici tradizionali e da fonti rinnovabili (principalmente solare e cogenerazione), oltre a soluzioni innovative di accumulo (produzione idrogeno, BESS). Responsabilità principali Progettazione di impianti elettrici in bassa e media tensione per il settore energetico, con focus su impianti fotovoltaici, cogenerazione, sistemi di accumulo e soluzioni per l'efficientamento energetico. Redazione di schemi elettrici, planimetrie e documentazione tecnica a supporto di installazione e manutenzione degli impianti. Integrazione degli impianti con i sistemi di monitoraggio e controllo. Gestione del rapporto tecnico con i fornitori: redazione delle specifiche tecniche per gli acquisti, analisi tecnica delle offerte e allineamento con le esigenze di progetto. Supporto alla direzione tecnica nella definizione delle soluzioni progettuali e nella scelta delle apparecchiature. Gestione delle richieste di collegamento alla rete BT/MT e redazione della relativa documentazione tecnica specialistica (schemi elettrici, regolamenti di esercizio, ecc.). Collaborazione con il team operativo per l'implementazione e la supervisione delle attività di cantiere. Requisiti Si valutano candidature sia Junior che Senior; la seniority sarà commisurata all'esperienza. Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o Diploma Tecnico con esperienza equivalente. Gradita esperienza nella progettazione di impianti da fonti rinnovabili (fotovoltaico, cogenerazione, BESS) e/o sistemi di alimentazione in Media e Bassa Tensione. Conoscenza delle normative elettriche (CEI, UNI, ecc.) e delle principali procedure autorizzative. Capacità di utilizzo di software di progettazione elettrica (es. AutoCAD, EPLAN, INTEGRA, ecc.). Costituisce plus la conoscenza di strumenti di simulazione energetica e software per il dimensionamento di impianti fotovoltaici (es. PV*SOL, PVSyst). Cosa offriamo Contratto a tempo indeterminato con inserimento diretto in azienda. CCNL commercio. Range di RAL: Junior 27-35K; Senior 40-50K Contesto in forte sviluppo nel settore della Green Economy con progetti tecnologicamente avanzati. Team tecnico strutturato e possibilità di crescita professionale sia in termini di responsabilità sia di competenze. Per realtà strutturata e in crescita nel settore aeronautico/aerospace, con sede a Latina, ricerchiamo un/una Progettista Meccanico Senior da inserire nel reparto R&D (team composto da 3 risorse). La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e nell'ottimizzazione del design, con responsabilità tecniche e di guida verso le risorse junior. ANNUNCIO DI LAVORO - PROGETTISTA MECCANICO SENIOR - R&D | SETTORE AEROSPACE | LATINA Chi cerchiamo Un/a professionista con esperienza consolidata in progettazione meccanica, preferibilmente in ambito aeronautico, capace di unire approccio R&D, attenzione alla producibilità e attitudine al coordinamento tecnico. Principali responsabilità Progettazione & Sviluppo: progettazione di componenti e sistemi aeronautici complessi, sviluppo di modelli CAD 3D e redazione di tavole costruttive di dettaglio. R&D e Innovazione: contributo alla definizione di nuovi concept di prodotto, verifica della producibilità e ottimizzazione continua delle soluzioni tecniche. title: ricercatore universitario/ricercatrice universitaria
description: Grafton LifeScience - Valorizziamo il tuo potenziale nel mondo LifeScience Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, dedicati a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito R&D, Clinical Research, Regulatory, Quality e Operation per il settore Farmaceutico e Medicale. Lavoriamo per accompagnare ogni persona verso le mansioni e i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le sue competenze e aspettative. Per il Gruppo Sterling, sede di Malta, ricerchiamo un/una QP & QA Manager con solida esperienza in ambito GMP, a supporto del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del Sistema Qualità aziendale. Costituisce requisito essenziale il possesso dei requisiti di QP eligibility secondo la normativa vigente applicabile (EU/Malta). Perché Sterling e perché Malta? - Internazionalità che arricchisce: un team di 8 nazionalità diverse, dove ogni giorno si impara a leggere situazioni nuove e a crescere anche sul piano personale. - Crescita reale e visibilità: il talento viene riconosciuto, la fiducia è concreta. title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Vairuotojas - kurjeris su B kategorija
description:
Pasikrauti siuntas į mikroautobusą ir pristatyti jas pagal nustatytą maršrutą. 90% siuntų yra nuo dokumentų voko iki 5 kg pakuotės. Maksimalus vieneto kiekis - 25kg. Per dieną nuvažiuojamas atstumas apie 70 km. Per dieną padarysite apie 15 000 žingsnių -puiki kasdieninė apmokama fizinė veikla. Surinkti užsakymus iš klientų. Mandagiai ir profesionaliai bendrauti su klientais. Užtikrinti darbo kokybės rodiklių laikymąsi. Ko tikimės iš savo komandos nario? B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimo ir saugaus vairavimo įgūdžių. Atsakingo požiūrio į darbą, punktualumo ir komunikabilumo. Panašaus darbo patirties – privalumas, bet ne būtinybė (visko išmokysime!). Grįžote po karinės tarnybos - puiku.
Jei dirbote Wolt ar Bolt pristatymo platformose, Jūsų patirtis yra puiki. Jums bus apmokėtas PSD, VSD, turėsite apmokamas atostogas. Nebijosite pajamų deklaracijos, nes mokesčiai yra sumokami iškart.

title: Jaunesnysis testavimo inžinierius (-ė)
description:
Puiki galimybė pradėti karjerą programinės įrangos testavimo srityje!

Programinės įrangos įmonė, kurianti įterptinius (embedded) sprendimus ir užtikrinanti jų kokybę medicinos prietaisų sektoriuje šiuo metu ieško specialistų, turinčių minimalios rankinio testavimo patirties, arba kandidatų, pasižyminčių stipria motyvacija mokytis ir pradėti testuotojo (-os) kelią.

Prisijungę prie šio projekto taptumėte tarptautinės komandos dalimi ir dirbtumėte jaunesniojo (-osios) testavimo inžinieriaus (-ės) pozicijoje, prisidedant prie hemodializės įrenginio vystymo. Darbą pradėtumėt nuo bazinių testavimo užduočių ir testų vykdymo, įgyjus patirties, jūsų atsakomybės nuosekliai plėstųsi į sudėtingesnes testavimo veiklas.

Ko tikimės iš Jūsų:
• Minimalios patirties arba teorinių žinių apie testavimą, arba noto mokytis bei augti QA (kokybės užtikrinimo) pozicijoje;
• Bent bazinių programinės įrangos testavimo teorijos žinių (bus vertinama pokalbio metu);
• Kruopštumo, noro mokytis ir proaktyvaus požiūrio;
• Gerų anglų kalbos žinių (raštu ir žodžiu);
• Elektronikos žinių – privalumas.

Mes Jums siūlome:
• Pagalbą – šalia turėsite mentorių („buddy“);
• Lankstų darbo laiką ir atostogų planavimą;
• Nuotolinius ir kontaktinius mokymus / dirbtuves bei kitas žinių dalijimosi galimybes;
• Papildomą sveikatos ir nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
• Užkandžius ir smagias veiklas biure;
• Lanksčią („Agile“), draugišką ir tarptautinę aplinką;
• Atlyginimą (bruto) 1400–2500 Eur/mėn. (derinama pagal kompetencijas).

Darbo vieta: Ukmergės g. 322-1, Vilnius

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Join our Digital Factory at Deloitte Luxembourg — a multidisciplinary team of ~85 technology professionals and financial domain experts working together to build high-impact digital solutions for the financial sector. Your advantages of joining us:


Work that has real impact

Build and architect data-intensive applications used by major financial institutions, leveraging modern engineering standards and AI-enabled tooling. Your decisions will directly influence product quality and client outcomes.


Technical leadership & career growth

Take ownership of architectural decisions and technical direction, with a clear path toward Lead Engineer and Architect roles. Benefit from a dedicated learning budget, internal tech talks, and access to Deloitte's global knowledge network.


Global reach, local roots

Contribute to international projects and collaborate with diverse teams across Deloitte's global network, all while being anchored in Luxembourg – one of Europe's leading financial centers.


Flexible, inclusive culture

We trust our people. Enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, a culture where your voice genuinely shapes how we work, and a team that values both performance and wellbeing.

Engineering & Architecture:

•    Define and apply sound architectural patterns (e.g., clean architecture, CQRS, event-driven design) appropriate to the problem at hand

Quality & Engineering Standards:

•    Proactively identify technical debt and drive pragmatic remediation plans


Leadership & Collaboration:

•    Act as a technical mentor for junior and mid-level engineers, supporting their growth through pairing, feedback, and knowledge sharing
•    Lead technical discussions and drive consensus across engineers and business stakeholders
•    Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable technical designs
•    Contribute to hiring by participating in technical interviews and candidate assessments
•    Communicate delivery risks, scope, and progress transparently to the team and project leads


Agile & Continuous Improvement:

•    Propose and implement improvements to team processes, tooling, and ways of working

University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another relevant field.
Fluent English is required. French is considered an asset.
5 to 10 years of hands-on experience in software development, with a proven track record of delivering complex, production-grade full-stack applications. Experience in the financial sector is a plus.
Technical skills : C#/.NET (Core), SQL/relational databases, React development, API design, CI/CD definition.Nice-to-have: Cloud platforms, Containerization, Event-driven architecture, AI integration.
Technical leadership: Ability to lead design discussions, make well-reasoned decisions under ambiguity, and bring others along
Mentorship mindset: Genuine interest in growing the people around you through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing
Ownership: You drive delivery, raise risks early, unblock your team, and take pride in what you ship

title: JUNIOR ENGINEER IN FUNGAL BIOINFORMATICS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

As a Junior R&T Engineer at LIST, you will work under close supervision, performing tasks according to plans and directions. You will contribute to RDI projects, manage laboratory equipment, and develop your skills in RDI methodologies and technical instruments.

Among other responsibilities, you will:
·                  In coordination with the Head of R&T Group, you will perform RDI engineering duties.
·                  Under the supervision of scientific staff, you will organise the group's laboratories and equipment, order chemicals and other materials, and introduce new group members to the team and institute's way of working
·                  Develop the ability to generate RDI results under supervision
·                  Manage the group's strain, enzyme and plasmid collection
·                  Independently perform short subprojects under general supervision of the group leader or group scientists.
·                  Document test or experiment proceedings and ensure the traceability and quality of results.
·                  Support the group in experimental tasks, especially in more routine experiments.
·                  Perform R&T tasks, under supervision when required: evaluate, select, and applytechnical methods; make critical analysis, evaluation, and synthesis of data obtained from tests/experiments; propose improvements to methods, techniques, or practices; evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of solutions provided; explain methods, practices and procedures related to their work; explain the functioning, usage, and maintenance of specialised tools/equipment
·                  Provide support to on-going funding efforts.
·                  Assit in the dissemination, valorisation, and transfer of RDI results. Presents work results in team meetings and workshops.
·                  Organise own work, defining timelines, and interacting collaboratively with team members.
·                  Learn to use specialized tools/equipment and advanced analytical techniques or methods.
·                  Respect and apply LIST-HSE rules. Alert potential dangers or risks. Take care of their own safety and that of others.


Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

•                   MSc (or equivalent) in molecular biology or biotechnology
•                   First experience (eg during studies) with molecular methodologies, such as cloning, RNA/gDNA isolation, PCR, etc.
•                   Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
•                   Experience with enzymes assays and/or HPLC analysis is an asset
•                   Experience with fungi is an asset
•                   Ability and willingness to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
•                   Strong interpersonal and communication skills

Language skills

•                   Strong knowledge of English (both spoken and written) is required.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
·        Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
·        Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
·        Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
·        Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:
·        A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
·        A scientific CV with contact details
·        List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
·        Contact details of 2 references
Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.
As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
This position offers a gross monthly salary between €5043 and €6132, paid over 13 months (€65559–€79716 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

title: Prévisionniste en météorologie (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Administration de la navigation aérien/ienne (ANA), rattachée au ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics, est le fournisseur de services de navigation aérien/ienne du Luxembourg, basée à Findel. Notre mission est de garantir un trafic aérien sûr, efficace et respectueux de l'environnement dans les espaces aériens nationaux et délégués ainsi qu'à l'aérodrome. Missions Afin de renforcer notre département Météorologie, nous recrutons un(e) Prévisionniste en météorologie. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez directement à une mission d'intérêt public essentielle : assurer la sécurité des opérations aérien/iennes grâce à une expertise météorologique de haut niveau, tout en contribuant aux missions météorologiques nationales. La météorologie aéronautique est une discipline scientifique exigeant/ante qui repose sur l'analyse de phénomènes s complexes, l'interprétation de modèles numériques et la prise de décisions en temps réel. Pour réussir dans cette fonction ainsi que dans la formation spécialisée dispensée par nos partenaires internationaux, un intérêt marqué pour les sciences ainsi que de solides bases en mathématiques, et sciences de la nature constituent de véritables atouts. Vous serez notamment chargé(e) de : Analyser et interpréter les observations et données météorologiques (satellites, radars, réseaux de détection de la foudre, modèles numériques, etc.) ; Élaborer, actualiser et diffuser les prévisions météorologiques nationales et aéronautiques ; Produire les messages météorologiques destinés aux usagers de l'aviation conformément aux normes internationales ; Assurer une veille météorologique permanente et diffuser les alertes en cas de phénomènes dangereux ; Fournir une assistance météorologique aux pilotes, aux services de la navigation aérien/ienne et aux autres partenaires opérationnels ; Collaborer avec les organismes météorologiques nationaux et internationaux ; Contribuer au maintien et à l'amélioration continue du système de management de la qualité, de la sécurité et de l'environnement du département ; Promouvoir et appliquer les principes de la Just Culture au sein de l'ANA. Le poste s'exerce dans le cadre d'un service continu heures sur et 7 jours sur 7, selon un système de travail en équipes comprenant les soirées, les nuits, les week-ends et les jours fériés. Ce que l'ANA a à vous offrir : L'ANA investit pleinement dans votre développement professionnel. Vous bénéficierez d'une formation spécialisée en météorologie entier/ièrement financée par l'ANA, d'une durée de à mois, auprès d'institutions européennes de référence telles que : Le Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) à Langen (Allemagne) ; L'École Nationale de la Météorologie de Météo-France à Toulouse (France). Cette formation couvre notamment : La de l'atmosphère ; La thermodynamique ; La dynamique des fluides ; Les mathématiques appliquées ; Les modèles numériques de prévision ; La météorologie aéronautique ; L'analyse scientifique des phénomènes météorologiques. La réussite de cette formation nécessite une réelle appétence pour les disciplines scientifiques ainsi qu'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'analyse. Le recrutement des prévisionnistes en météorologie est particulier/ièrement exigeant afin de garantir la réussite de la formation spécialisée et l'exercice d'une fonction essentielle à la sécurité aérien/ienne. Le processus de sélection comprend plusieurs étapes : Analyse des candidatures et vérification des conditions d'admission; Test d'anglais; Épreuves écrites visant notamment à évaluer : Les capacités de raisonnement scientifique et logique ; Les connaissances générales en mathématiques, et sciences ; Les aptitudes analytiques. Entretien devant une commission de sélection, permettant d'apprécier la motivation, les compétences comportementales, la capacité d'apprentissage et l'adéquation du candidat avec les exigences de la fonction. Compte tenu du niveau d'exigence de la formation et des responsabilités confiées aux prévisionnistes, seuls les candidats démontrant de solides aptitudes scientifiques, analytiques et comportementales pourront poursuivre le processus de sélection. Exercer une profession scientifique passionnant/ante ayant un impact direct sur la sécurité aérien/ienne ; Intégrer une administration moderne, dynamique et tournée vers l'innovation ; Évoluer aux côtés de spécialistes reconnus dans leur domaine ; Bénéficier d'un parcours de formation de très haut niveau reconnu à l'échelle européenne ; Développer continuellement vos compétences dans un environnement international ; Partager les valeurs de l'ANA : Intégrité, Respect, Innovation, Engagement et Excellence. Vous êtes prêt(e) à relever ce défi ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez acteur...

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (.NET & React) (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:

Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg

Seniority:  Senior levels

On site
Full time


Your future team:

Join our Digital Factory at Deloitte Luxembourg — a multidisciplinary team of ~85 technology professionals and financial domain experts working together to build high-impact digital solutions for the financial sector. We develop modern, data-driven products serving clients in banking, investment funds, and asset management, in a collaborative Agile environment with a strong focus on engineering quality and continuous improvement.

As a Senior Engineer, you will be a key technical pillar of the team – owning solutions end-to-end, shaping our engineering practices, and helping grow the people around you.



Your advantages of joining us:


Work that has real impact

Build and architect data-intensive applications used by major financial institutions, leveraging modern engineering standards and AI-enabled tooling. Your decisions will directly influence product quality and client outcomes.


Technical leadership & career growth

Take ownership of architectural decisions and technical direction, with a clear path toward Lead Engineer and Architect roles. Benefit from a dedicated learning budget, internal tech talks, and access to Deloitte's global knowledge network.


Global reach, local roots

Contribute to international projects and collaborate with diverse teams across Deloitte's global network, all while being anchored in Luxembourg – one of Europe's leading financial centers.


Flexible, inclusive culture

We trust our people. Enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, a culture where your voice genuinely shapes how we work, and a team that values both performance and wellbeing.


A team that builds together

Work side by side with financial experts, product owners, and fellow engineers in a startup-minded environment within a globally recognized firm.



How you'll contribute to our success:


Engineering & Architecture:

•    Architect, develop, and own robust full-stack applications from concept to production, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, and maintainability in a financial services context
•    Design and implement high-performance, data-intensive APIs, processing workflows, and integrations using C#/.NET and SQL Server
•    Define and apply sound architectural patterns (e.g., clean architecture, CQRS, event-driven design) appropriate to the problem at hand
•    Build scalable, performant user interfaces with React, applying strong component architecture and state management best practices


Quality & Engineering Standards:

•    Define, promote, and enforce engineering standards across the team: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E), and CI/CD pipeline ownership
•    Own non-functional requirements including performance, security, and observability
•    Proactively identify technical debt and drive pragmatic remediation plans


Leadership & Collaboration:

•    Act as a technical mentor for junior and mid-level engineers, supporting their growth through pairing, feedback, and knowledge sharing
•    Lead technical discussions and drive consensus across engineers and business stakeholders
•    Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable technical designs
•    Contribute to hiring by participating in technical interviews and candidate assessments
•    Communicate delivery risks, scope, and progress transparently to the team and project leads


Agile & Continuous Improvement:

•    Champion Agile best practices within the team, contributing to sprint ceremonies with a focus on sustainable delivery and continuous improvement
•    Propose and implement improvements to team processes, tooling, and ways of working


Your skills:

University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another relevant field.
Fluent English is required. French is considered an asset.
5 to 10 years of hands-on experience in software development, with a proven track record of delivering complex, production-grade full-stack applications. Experience in the financial sector is a plus.
Technical skills : C#/.NET (Core), SQL/relational databases, React development, API design, CI/CD definition.Nice-to-have: Cloud platforms, Containerization, Event-driven architecture, AI integration.
Technical leadership: Ability to lead design discussions, make well-reasoned decisions under ambiguity, and bring others along
Mentorship mindset: Genuine interest in growing the people around you through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing
Ownership: You drive delivery, raise risks early, unblock your team, and take pride in what you ship


Interested? Please submit your resume in English

With more than 2,600 employees and 98 nationalities, Deloitte Luxembourg is one of the Grand Duchy's largest, strongest and oldest professional services firms. For more than 75 years, our talented teams have been serving clients in various industries delivering high added-value offerings to national and international clients in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. Deloitte Luxembourg is part of the global Deloitte network.

Deloitte provides leading professional services to nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500® and thousands of private companies. Our people deliver measurable and lasting results that help reinforce public trust in capital markets and enable clients to transform and thrive. title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.
    Proven experience (10+ years) in a senior finance role within a supply chain or manufacturing environment.
    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.
    Systems / ERP capability
        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English
    Additional language skills considered an asset

title: Life Actuary (m/f)
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic and highly motivated life actuary to join our LUX actuarial team. The role will provide valuable actuarial experience into life insurance and reinsurance business. You will support the day to day tasks of the actuarial team in relation to valuation of reserves (Local GAAP and Solvency II), including the financial reporting process, asset liability management analyses, assumption setting and participating in various actuarial projects both at local or group level. The life actuary will be fully involved in actuarial projects, supporting integration of new portfolios.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 Assist in the quarterly closing process including calculation and control of local GAAP reserves, analysis of margins
 Assist in the quarterly Solvency II reporting
 Assist the actuarial team in the preparation of the reinsurance accounting
 Assist in the preparation of group and regulatory disclosures and reports
 Assist with the production of the annual experience investigations (biometric experience, expense reserves…),  and the recommendations of actuarial assumptions
 Assist with business planning and stress testing processes
 Assist the risk management function in the implementation and production of assets or ALM risk indicators
 Assist with the annual expense reserve process
 Assist in the preparation of the actuarial function report, and SFCR / RSR
 Support the risk team with the ORSA process and quantitative analyses
  Provide actuarial support to other teams, particularly Finance, Investments and Risk

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

 Master degree in actuarial science, with an actuarial qualification
 Experience of 2 to 3 years within an insurance / or consulting insurance
 Experiences in coding (R, Python, IA), data and process improvement are key
 Solvency II experience is an asset
 Fluent in English, French is an asset
 Effective communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
 Dynamic team player able to collaborate and share with other colleagues
 Curious with an appetite to learn and agile
 Energetic and passionate with a positive attitude and solution oriented
 Willing to accept a variety of challenging technical and non-technical matters

title: Gestionnaire d'estimations des pensions (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Avec ses quelques  collaborateurs, la Caisse nationale d'assurance pension (CNAP) est un établissement public ayant comme mission la gestion de l'assurance pension du régime général. En tant qu'interlocuteur unique en matier/ière de pension de tous les assurés du secteur privé, les salariés et non-salariés, elle assure le traitement des dossiers de pension et le paiement des prestations correspondant/antes. Dans l'exécution de ses missions, la CNAP collabore avec un large réseau de partenaires nationaux et internationaux et privilégie une gestion participative à tous les niveaux. La cellule « estimation des pensions » du service pension accompagne les futurs retraités en leur fournissant des conseils et évaluations personnalisées sur leurs droits à la retraite. Il analyse les carrier/ières d'assurance conformément aux réglementations nationales et internationales pour offrir des projections permettant aux assurés de planifier leur transition vers la retraite. La CNAP offre un environnement de travail collégial et pluridisciplinaire, un travail varié en constant/ante évolution et des possibilités de développement personnel. Atouts Avoir des connaissances sur l'assurance pension et l'affiliation; Avoir une premier/ière expérience professionnelle dans le traitement de dossiers administratifs. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 4 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). Expertise IA: Maîtrise des techniques de Machine Learning et d'Advanced Analytics (clustering, Random Forest, Boosting, réseaux de neurones, NLP, etc.); Expertise approfondie en Privacy Enhancing Technologies (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, agrégation, suppression, généralisation, etc.); Expérience dans l'évaluation de modèles, la conception de suites de tests et l'analyse des limites des algorithmes; Connaissance des modèles de langage et des outils d'IA générative appliqués à des cas d'usage privacy et confidentialité. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez...

Vous conseillez les agents: Vous répondez aux questions des agents; Vous organisez des entrevues avec les agents. title: Analyste financier (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Dans le cadre de la loi modifiée du 7 août  relative au logement abordable, le département du Logement a un rôle central dans le suivi, l'analyse et le pilotage des dispositifs de financement du logement abordable. À ce titre, le département assure notamment : le suivi financier des mécanismes de compensation de service public accordés aux promoteurs et bailleurs sociaux; l'instruction et l'analyse des dossiers soumis aux commissions compétentes, notamment la Commission d'Acquisition Logement Abordable (CAL) et la Commission d'Acquisition Foncier (CAF); l'instruction et l'analyse des demandes d'aides à la pierre soumises pour avis à la Commission d'Accompagnement des Aides à la Pierre (CAAP); la gestion et le contrôle des aides à la pierre, incluant l'évaluation de leur impact financier et budgétaire; le développement d'outils d'analyse et de reporting permettant d'assurer la transparence et la soutenabilité des dispositifs. Dans un contexte marqué par une complexification croissant/ante des montages de projets, une diversification des acteurs et une augmentation significative des volumes financiers engagés, le département doit renforcer son expertise en analyse financier/ière, en modélisation économique et en évaluation des risques. Missions Analyser les bilans, comptes de résultats et annexes, tableaux de flux de trésorerie afin de définir la  financier/ière (croissance, endettement, rentabilité) des promoteurs sociaux et constructeurs; Réaliser des analyses financier/ières de projets de logements (sur base de plans de financement et business plans); Vérifier à postériori et/ou sur base d'échantillons les calculs de compensation de service public; Effectuer des contrôles ex post sur base d'échantillons des loyers; Produire des rapports et recommandations; Piloter et coordonner tout type de projet en lien avec les activités du service et en concertation et/ou pour le compte d'autres services du ministère; Toute autre tâche en relation avec l'analyse financier/ière. Profil Compétences techniques Solide maîtrise de l'analyse financier/ière, incluant la capacité à interpréter de manier/ière autonome les bilans, comptes de résultats et flux de trésorerie; Expérience confirmée dans l'analyse financier/ière approfondie; Capacité à formuler des avis financiers argumentés et à agir comme référent technique; Bonne compréhension du financement immobilier; Capacité d'analyse de données complexes; Maîtrise des outils Excel; Maîtrise avancée des outils d'intelligence artificielle appliqués à l'analyse financier/ière. Compétences comportementales Rigueur et précision; Esprit critique; Autonomie; Sens des responsabilités; Bonnes capacités de communication. Atouts Expérience dans le secteur bancaire; Expérience dans une fonction impliquant l'analyse financier/ière; Expérience en analyse de projets immobiliers; Connaissance du logement abordable. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en finance, économie, gestion ou domaine connexe ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise.
