Job Description & Summary

In tax reporting strategy at PwC, you will assist clients in developing tax reporting strategies and maintaining compliance with tax regulations. In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.

Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior in Operational tax team (m/f/d). What if it was you?

We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,600 people from more than 90 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  
Our Operational Tax department is growing and we are looking for a motivated professional eager to take on real responsibility in a dynamic and international environment. As a Senior Associate within our FATCA/CRS dedicated team, you will be a trusted advisor to financial institutions navigating complex regulatory landscapes — from private equity and real estate to banking and asset management.

Your mission:

Your role sits at the intersection of tax, operations, and compliance. Concretely, you will:
Advise and support clients on their FATCA, CRS, QI and DAC6 obligations - from entity classification and investor on-boarding to due diligence and annual reporting. You will be their go-to contact for technical questions, guiding them through regulatory requirements with clarity and confidence.
Review and validate a wide range of client documentation - self-certification forms, U.S. withholding certificates, account opening forms, master files, and XML FATCA/CRS reports - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable legislation.
Drive quality and oversight by preparing gap analyses, controls reports and sign-off reports, QI  and DAC6 reports, monitoring regulatory update impacting our clients and consulting and reporting services.
Contribute to projects and initiatives that shape how the team operates - from building and refining internal processes and methodologies to exploring how to bring more efficiency and intelligence to compliance work.  
Collaborate and grow in close cooperation with colleagues across the Operational Tax department and beyond. You will contribute to tailored client solutions, support junior team members, and benefit from a training programme that you can shape according to your own development goals.

Let's talk about you

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Tax, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field;
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in the financial services industry;
• Have solid knowledge of FATCA, CRS and/or QI legislation;
• Are comfortable working with data — databases, structured reports, and XML environments;
• Are a strong communicator who enjoys daily client interactions and can explain complex topics with clarity;
• Have a proactive mindset and a genuine interest in process improvement, project work, and new technologies including AI;
• Are fluent in English and French - any additional language is a plus.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

International and entrepreneurial Scandinavian working environment

title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.
    Analyze the financial impact of inventory-related decisions and provide recommendations for improvement.

6.      Financial Support CAPEX (Capital Expenditures):

    Collaborate with the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) team to assess the financial feasibility and impact of proposed capital projects within the Supply Chain division.
    Conduct thorough financial analysis and risk assessments for CAPEX investments, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals and strategies.
    Assist in the preparation of CAPEX budgets, forecasts, and business cases.
    Provide financial insights and recommendations to guide decision-making on CAPEX projects, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and optimal return on investment (ROI).

Qualifications:

    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

    Strong financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting skills.

        Hands-on or leadership experience with ERP costing modules, project accounting, service costing, data structures, integrations, and reporting architecture.
    Excellent leadership and communication skills.
    Ability to work collaboratively across functional teams.
    Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
    Fluent in English

The successful candidate will have an active role within our established team of international academics in the areas of teaching, curriculum development, quality enhancement, academic governance and research at LUNEX.
A main focus of professional activities will be the delivery of lectures and coordination of learning modules of a study programme in the field of Nutrition, Fitness and Health. The position furthermore requires the development of and participation in interdisciplinary research activities. This position offers an excellent opportunity to take part in the shaping of a young & dynamic university with high ambitions in health, performance and management-related education as well as research with international and multidisciplinary scope.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS
Candidates should have, at minimum, a Bachelor degree in an area relevant to the position, a PhD in an area relevant to the position is considered and advantage.
Knowledge in Biomedical Sciences is considered essential. Particular area of interest are:
1. Diet therapy
2. Clinical Nutrition
3. Nutrient Metabolism
4. Dietary counselling

In rating competent applicants, the following criteria will be emphasized:
• Educational background in Dietetics is necessary for this position
• Clinical experience as a licensed Dietetics is necessary for this position
• Ability to deliver learning modules and classes at under-graduate and post-graduate levels
• Proven excellence of teaching in higher education area
• Research track record as evidenced by publications in relevant peer reviewed journals
• Other documented qualifications relevant for the position (presentations at scientific events and/or congresses, public communications, ...)
• Good interpersonal skills and team management experience
• Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively to students using a variety of teaching methods, thereby enhancing the student experience
• High level of spoken and written English language skills (English is the language of tuition at LUNEX)
• Proficiency in French or German or Luxembourgish is considered an advantage

Required documents for the application:
Motivation Letter
CV

WE OFFER
A dynamic and stimulating work environment within an international team of experts.
We aim to be an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all sections of the community.
The salary is competitive and in line with qualifications and experience.

title: Process Safety Management (PSM) Coordinator (m/f)
description:
In this highly visible position, you will partner with operations, technical teams, site leadership, and global Tyvek® colleagues to strengthen process safety performance, drive compliance excellence, and advance a proactive safety culture. You will serve as a key subject matter expert, ensuring robust Process Safety Management practices are embedded across the organization and helping shape the future of process safety within the global Tyvek® network.
This role offers the opportunity to collaborate internationally, influence strategic safety initiatives, and make a meaningful impact on one of the world's leading manufacturing operations.

What You'll Do
As the PSM Coordinator, you will lead and coordinate critical process safety activities, including:
Driving the site's Process Safety Management program in alignment with regulatory requirements, corporate standards, audit findings, and risk assessment recommendations.
Supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of PSM systems, programs, and procedures.
Facilitating and participating in key risk management processes, including Management of Change (MOC) and Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR).
Leading and supporting Process Hazard Analyses (PHAs), process safety reviews, and PSM audits to identify and mitigate operational risks.
Ensuring PHA studies are effectively planned, executed, and tracked to closure.
Reviewing and approving operating procedures, standards, and practices related to PSM-covered processes.
Chairing the quarterly Tyvek® PSM Committee and representing Tyvek® within the broader site PSM governance structure.
Driving a strong process safety culture by promoting best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborating with colleagues across the global Tyvek® manufacturing network, including our sister plant, to share knowledge and align on process safety priorities.
Participating in global Tyvek® process safety initiatives, including causal analysis reviews, incident learnings, PRS assessments, ATEX-related activities, and other risk management programs.
Supporting incident investigations, root cause analyses, and risk assessments to prevent recurrence and improve operational reliability.

What We Are Looking For
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Fluency in German and English.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, operational technologies, and/or Process Safety Management principles.
Knowledge of Process Safety Management systems, Process Hazard Analysis methodologies, and EHS regulations.
Proven ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within Tyvek® operations or other high-hazard manufacturing environments.
Familiarity with DuPont standards and process safety requirements.
Knowledge of ATEX regulations and risk management frameworks.
French language skills.

title: Coordinateur/trice de projet (m/f/d)
employer: Secrétariat du Sommet de la Grande Région GECT S.E.
description:
FICHE DE POSTE

1. Missions

Véritable point de référence du projet, le/la coordinateur/trice de projet veille à la bonne mise en oeuvre du projet avec les partenaires dans le respect des exigences du programme Interreg Grande Région.

Le/la coordinateur/trice de projet est notamment chargé/e des missions suivantes :

Pilotage et coordination générale du projet, coordination des modules de travail 2 et 3

• Assurer la direction opérationnelle et la coordination générale du projet et en concertation avec les partenaires dans le respect de la convention de financement, du calendrier, du budget et des objectifs fixés
• Veiller à la bonne mise en oeuvre du projet, au suivi des livrables, des indicateurs de réalisation et de résultat ainsi qu'à l'atteinte des objectifs définis
• Coordonner transversalement les trois modules de travail et assurer la cohérence des actions menées par l'ensemble des partenaires
• Assurer plus particulièrement la coordination du module de travail 3 « Expliquer la Grande Région » et la co-coordination du module de travail
2 « Cycle de séminaires – compétences transfrontalières », en collaboration avec les partenaires responsables
• Identifier les éventuels risques liés à la mise en oeuvre du projet et proposer les mesures correctives nécessaires

Coordination du partenariat et représentation du projet

• Animer le réseau des partenaires financiers et méthodologiques
• Organiser les réunions de partenariat dont le Comité d'accompagnement (COMAC) annuel, préparer les ordres du jour, rédiger les comptes-rendus et assurer le suivi des actions décidées
• Assurer une circulation efficace de l'information entre les partenaires
• Participer aux échanges avec les partenaires institutionnels et représenter le projet auprès des parties prenantes
• Représenter le projet auprès du Secrétariat conjoint et de l'Autorité de gestion du programme Interreg Grande Région

Gestion du projet et assurer le suivi des critères de financement du programme Interreg

Pour ce volet, le/la coordinateur/trice de projet pourra s'appuyer sur un/e contributeur/trice de projet recruté/e dans le cadre du projet

• Assurer le suivi administratif et financier courant du projet en lien avec les partenaires
• Suivre l'exécution budgétaire, les dépenses engagées et la consommation des crédits, notamment du GECT, dans le cadre des déclarations de créances trimestrielles
• Suivre et reportage trimestrielle concernant les indicateurs du projet
• Coordonner la rédaction des rapports intermédiaire et final
• Organiser le COMAC annuel et préparer les documents de séance
• Coordonner la préparation des déclarations de créances consolidées et des reversements de la part FEDER aux partenaires financiers dans les délais prescrits
• Veiller au respect des règles d'éligibilité des dépenses, des procédures de marchés publics et des obligations liées au financement FEDER en coopération avec les partenaires du projet
• Assurer le suivi documentaire du projet, la collecte des pièces justificatives et l'archivage conformément aux exigences du programme en coopération avec les partenaires du projet
• Mettre en oeuvre la stratégie de communication du projet en lien avec les partenaires
• Veiller au respect des obligations de publicité et de visibilité du programme Interreg Grande Région
• Coordonner la production des supports de communication, des contenus et des ressources liés au projet en coopération avec les partenaires du projet
• Contribuer à la valorisation des résultats du projet auprès des administrations, des institutions partenaires et du grand public

Relations hiérarchiques et gouvernance

Le/la coordinateur/trice de projet exerce ses fonctions sous l'autorité directe de la gérante du GECT Secrétariat du Sommet de la Grande Région.

La gérante assure la supervision stratégique du projet, veille à sa bonne exécution globale et procède aux arbitrages nécessaires à l'atteinte des objectifs fixés. Elle assure également la représentation institutionnelle du chef de file, valide les orientations stratégiques, les rapports officiels ainsi que toute décision engageant le GECT.

Le/la coordinateur/trice de projet est responsable de la mise en oeuvre opérationnelle quotidienne du projet. À ce titre, il/elle assure la coordination des activités, le suivi de l'avancement des actions et constitue l'interlocuteur/trice privilégié/e des partenaires pour les aspects liés à la gestion courante du projet.

Dans l'accomplissement de ses missions, le/la coordinateur/trice de projet s'appuie sur un/e contributeur/trice de projet qui contribue au bon déroulement du projet par un appui au suivi administratif, financier et communicationnel.

2. Profil requis

Formation et Expérience

• Diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur (niveau Master ou équivalent) dans un domaine pertinent pour la fonction : affaires européennes, coopération transfrontalière, administration publique, sciences politiques, gestion de projets, relations internationales ou domaine connexe
• Expérience professionnelle confirmée dans la gestion et la coordination de projets européens, idéalement dans le cadre d'un programme Interreg ou d'un autre programme de coopération territoriale européenne
• Expérience dans la coordination de partenariats associant plusieurs institutions publiques, administrations, organismes universitaires ou acteurs institutionnels, notamment dans le domaine transfrontalier
• Expérience dans le pilotage d'un projet en tant que chef de file ou coordinateur principal constitue un atout
• Une expérience dans un environnement transfrontalier, européen ou institutionnel constitue un avantage

Compétences professionnelles

• Bonne connaissance des politiques européennes de coopération territoriale et des mécanismes de financement européens, en particulier des programmes Interreg
• Connaissance des enjeux de la coopération transfrontalière et du fonctionnement institutionnel de la Grande Région, ou capacité démontrée à appréhender rapidement cet environnement institutionnel complexe
• Maîtrise des principes de gestion financière et opérationnelle des projets européens : suivi budgétaire, préparation de rapports, respect des règles d'éligibilité, suivi des contrôles et obligations liées aux financements européens ;
• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, de planification et de coordination de projets impliquant de nombreux partenaires
• Capacité à assurer le suivi simultané de plusieurs axes de travail, échéances, livrables et indicateurs
• Aptitude à animer des réseaux de partenaires, à faciliter les échanges entre institutions et à créer une dynamique collective autour d'objectifs communs
• Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse en français et en allemand, permettant de produire des documents de travail, comptes rendus, rapports et supports de communication dans les deux langues de travail de la Grande Région
• Bonne compréhension des enjeux de communication et de valorisation des projets européens

Qualités personnelles

• Excellent sens relationnel et aptitude à travailler dans un environnement institutionnel multiculturel et multilingue
• Sens de la diplomatie et de la coopération
• Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités
• Capacité d'anticipation, esprit d'initiative et aptitude à proposer des solutions
• Capacité à travailler en équipe tout en assurant un pilotage autonome des missions confiées
• Capacité à animer, fédérer et fidéliser des groupes de travail à distance
• Grande disponibilité et permis B obligatoire (des déplacements réguliers sur l'ensemble du territoire de coopération de la Grande Région sont à prévoir)

Compétences linguistiques

• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'allemand, langues de travail de la Grande Région

In tax reporting strategy at PwC, you will assist clients in developing tax reporting strategies and maintaining compliance with tax regulations. In this field, you will analyse financial data, interpret tax laws, and provide guidance on tax reporting requirements, aiming to optimise tax positions and minimise risks for businesses.

Senior Associate - FATCA/CRS - Operational tax team

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior in Operational tax team (m/f/d). What if it was you?

We are the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg, providing audit, tax and advisory services to a wide variety of clients. To make it happen, we count on the expertise of over 3,600 people from more than 90 different countries, who strive every day to reach excellence and team up to solve important problems through innovative solutions. We value diverse and singular career paths, embrace everyone's unique self and encourage our People to fuel their potential in a work environment that is inclusive, stimulating, and motivating.  
Our Operational Tax department is growing and we are looking for a motivated professional eager to take on real responsibility in a dynamic and international environment. As a Senior Associate within our FATCA/CRS dedicated team, you will be a trusted advisor to financial institutions navigating complex regulatory landscapes — from private equity and real estate to banking and asset management.

Your mission:

Your role sits at the intersection of tax, operations, and compliance. Concretely, you will:
Advise and support clients on their FATCA, CRS, QI and DAC6 obligations - from entity classification and investor on-boarding to due diligence and annual reporting. You will be their go-to contact for technical questions, guiding them through regulatory requirements with clarity and confidence.
Review and validate a wide range of client documentation - self-certification forms, U.S. withholding certificates, account opening forms, master files, and XML FATCA/CRS reports - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable legislation.
Drive quality and oversight by preparing gap analyses, controls reports and sign-off reports, QI  and DAC6 reports, monitoring regulatory update impacting our clients and consulting and reporting services.
Contribute to projects and initiatives that shape how the team operates - from building and refining internal processes and methodologies to exploring how to bring more efficiency and intelligence to compliance work.  
Collaborate and grow in close cooperation with colleagues across the Operational Tax department and beyond. You will contribute to tailored client solutions, support junior team members, and benefit from a training programme that you can shape according to your own development goals.

Let's talk about you

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Hold a Master's degree in Tax, Law, Economics, Business Administration or a related field;
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant experience, ideally gained in the financial services industry;
• Have solid knowledge of FATCA, CRS and/or QI legislation;
• Are comfortable working with data — databases, structured reports, and XML environments;
• Are a strong communicator who enjoys daily client interactions and can explain complex topics with clarity;
• Have a proactive mindset and a genuine interest in process improvement, project work, and new technologies including AI;
• Are fluent in English and French - any additional language is a plus.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: Relationship Manager (m/f)
description:
Description:


At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.


What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, you will be responsible for managing and growing a hybrid client portfolio covering:
• GRM-covered relationships (supporting and, where applicable, co-managing selected strategic relationships in partnership with the Global Relationship Manager), and
• GNB – Global Network Banking (Luxembourg and Continental Europe booking needs), including onboarding and ongoing relationship management.


You will focus on delivering sustainable revenue growth through the sale of transactional banking products booked in Luxembourg and Continental Europe, notably Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), as well as identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending, and Asset Management.


In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and grow revenues from the assigned hybrid portfolio (GRM-supported and GNB inbound corporate clients), including identifying cross-sell opportunities and supporting new client acquisition where relevant.
• Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day relationship coverage for designated clients, ensuring a consistent client experience across GRM, GNB and product partners.
• Support Global Relationship Manager (GRM) on selected strategic relationships by coordinating local execution in Luxembourg/Continental Europe (e.g., product delivery, pipeline tracking, client service issues, and internal stakeholder alignment).
• Cover GNB inbound corporate relationships end-to-end, including client engagement, solutioning, and coordination of onboarding and account maintenance activities.
• Take ownership of onboarding, KYC/CDD, periodic reviews and renewals, working closely with internal teams to ensure timely completion and high-quality submissions.
• Support credit-related activities (where applicable) and regularly monitor the portfolio and generate quality assets by utilising appropriate risk management tools, ensuring alignment with HSBC's risk appetite and pricing appropriately for risk.


You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in a client-facing relationship management role, ideally with exposure to global coverage models (e.g., GRM/local coverage) and international stakeholders.
• Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory issues.
• Ability to interact with Corporate and Institutional customers; product knowledge of credit – experience of writing draft credit applications and performing credit analysis is an advantage.
• Solid knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes, with a track record of driving timely completion across multiple stakeholders.
• Good knowledge of transaction banking products, primarily Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM) products.
• Strong IT skills to produce quality presentations and other material for client meetings/pitches (Excel, PowerPoint etc.) and strong written and spoken communication skills in English - knowledge of French or German is not mandatory but can be an asset.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.


What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 87,200 – 120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

title: Director Finance, Operations & Supply Chain (m/f/d)

Job Description

Husky Technologies is a global leader in Injection Molding Manufacturing, committed to delivering high-quality products and services to our customers. Based in Bolton, Canada, we are seeking a Finance Director to join our dynamic team. This role will play a crucial part in providing financial leadership for our Operations and Supply Chain divisions, working closely with various functions including Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Quality, and Central Operational Support.

You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all financial aspects of our Operations & Supply Chain, ensuring that financial goals are met and that financial strategies align with the company's broader objectives. Reporting to the VP Finance, FP&A, you will serve as the right-hand finance partner to the Chief Operating Officer. This role will be based in Bolton, Canada. With five direct reports and a team of ~10 individuals based in Bolton and Luxembourg, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's financial performance.

Key Accountabilities:

1.      Financial Planning and Analysis:

    Develop and manage the annual budget for the Operations and Supply Chain divisions.
    Provide financial guidance and insights to support decision-making processes.
    Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide monthly financial reports to the executive team.
    Lead the review and analysis of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
    Identify and analyze variances between actual results and budget/forecast, insights into the drives for variances.
    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the underlying factors contributing to financial performance.
    Proactively identify financial risks and opportunities, making recommendations to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
    Work closely with the executive team to refine financial strategies based on month-end and year-end insights.

2.      Cost Management:

    Transform current costing and methodology standards to improve transparency to product margins, life cycle costing and governance.
    Data and process design- Defining costing rules, master data requirements, controls, reporting definitions, and system-enabled workflows.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Collaborate closely with Supply Chain leaders to identify cost-saving opportunities and implement cost control measures across various aspects of the supply chain, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and production.
    Develop and monitor cost reduction initiatives and targets, ensuring alignment with the company's financial goals.
    Monitor and report on key cost-related performance indicators to the executive team, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.

3.      Strategic Planning:

    Work closely with the Leadership team to develop long-term financial strategies for the Operation and Supply Chain divisions.
    Transformation accountability- Owning roadmap, requirements, testing, change management, adoption, and benefits realization.
    Assess financial impacts of potential investments in supply chain infrastructure, technology, and capabilities to improve cost and lead time.

4.      Cross Functional Leadership:

    Ability to lead Finance, Operations, IT, Service, Commercial, and regional teams through process/system change.

5.      Inventory Management:

    Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders to establish appropriate inventory targets, and improve inventory forecasting.

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate – Infrastructure & Private Markets Valuation & Modelling (m/f/d). What if it was you?  

Your mission: A career in our Valuation & Modelling Services practice will provide you with the opportunity to work at the forefront of valuation, financial modelling, and investment analysis across private markets.

As part of the largest and most qualified dedicated valuation and modelling team in Luxembourg, you will advise leading alternative investment managers, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, private equity sponsors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and multinational corporations on complex valuation and modelling matters throughout the investment lifecycle.

Recognised as a centre of excellence for portfolio valuation, our team delivers independent valuations and reviews of investment portfolios, businesses, complex securities, financial instruments, and intangible assets for financial and investor reporting, regulatory compliance, governance, and strategic decision-making.

Our team also works closely with PwC Luxembourg's market-leading Assurance practice, supporting a broad range of valuation matters across audit engagements. This provides our professionals with unique exposure to valuation challenges across multiple asset classes, investment structures, and industries, while helping maintain the highest standards of quality, consistency, and professional rigour.

Our professionals come from diverse backgrounds, including leading asset managers, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, valuation boutiques, advisory practices, and audit firms. Together, we combine deep technical expertise with practical investment experience to help clients navigate increasingly sophisticated valuation challenges across infrastructure, private equity, venture capital, private debt, real estate, and other alternative asset classes.

Our multidisciplinary experience allows us to engage confidently with investment professionals, valuation committees, risk teams, boards of directors, external auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders to deliver robust, independent, and insightful analyses that support informed decision-making.


Be a part of our team where you will:

Carry out various assignments for valuation and modelling across different industries and situations, including portfolio valuations, business valuations, intangible valuations, complex securities valuation, and ad hoc modelling engagements;  
Prepare detailed financial modelling, business plans, financial analysis and the application of a variety of valuation methodologies;  
Assess reasonableness of valuations and financial models prepared by others;  
Assist clients with their understanding of complex financial structures;  
Apply generally accepted valuation principles, methodologies, and techniques in support of IPEV, IFRS, US GAAP and Lux GAAP;  
Perform valuation analyses of financial instruments, structured products, and complex capital structures;
Develop independent financial models using income, market, and option-based approaches;
Analyse complex situations and formulate practical, value-added recommendations;  
Leverage multiple data sources and stakeholder perspectives to develop robust conclusions;  
Use data and insights to support investment, governance, and reporting decisions;  
Develop a point of view on key market developments and emerging valuation trends;  
Manage multiple stakeholder perspectives and build consensus around complex issues;  
Communicate technical concepts in a clear and concise manner;  
Produce outstanding deliverables for clients across the private markets ecosystem;  
Continuously develop new skills and deepen your valuation, modelling, and investment expertise.


Let's talk about you. If you...

Hold a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field;
Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills, with excellent command of English — German and French are strong assets, and any other European language is considered valuable;
Have 2–5 years of professional experience in Valuation and Modelling, ideally gained within the valuation or modelling advisory team of a Big Four firm, a professional services firm (e.g., Mazars, BDO, Grant Thornton), or a specialist advisory firm (e.g., BHB Partners, Stout, VRC, Houlihan Lokey, Alvarez & Marsal, Accuracy, Eight Advisory);
Have exposure to private capital alternative investments (e.g., private equity, infrastructure, venture capital, private debt);
Experience in infrastructure and project finance valuation, financial modelling, transaction analysis, or investment appraisal would be highly valued;
Demonstrate strong financial modelling skills in Microsoft Excel — capable of building three-way models and adhering to best practices (e.g., avoiding hard-coded figures and inefficient formulas such as VLOOKUP, INDIRECT, or nested IFs);
Possess solid knowledge of financial statement analysis under IFRS, US GAAP, and/or Lux GAAP;
Have experience with option pricing models (e.g., Black-Scholes, Binomial Trees, Monte Carlo) and/or Purchase Price Allocations (considered valuable);
Can create high-quality deliverables using Microsoft PowerPoint;
Are progressing toward a professional finance or accounting qualification (e.g., CFA, CAIA, CPV, CVA, ASA, CBV, ACCA, ACA, CPA, CA, AFM, CFM, FMVA, FRM, CQF);
Are highly organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously;
Demonstrate a strong team attitude, a willingness to support others, share expertise, and contribute positively to a collaborative, high-performing culture;
Demonstrate strong attention to detail and a healthy level of professional skepticism;
Are proactive, intellectually curious, and committed to continuous learning;
Bring positive energy, humility, and a good sense of humor to the team.


…You are the candidate we are looking for!

Meet your future team

Join our Human Capital team within the centralized HR Service Center, the first point of contact for employees on HR administrative questions. You will work closely with HR expert teams to provide clear, reliable answers and support smooth employee administration across PwC Luxembourg.


What your role will look like

As an HR Service Center Officer, you will support employees through day-to-day HR administrative requests and help ensure employee questions are managed with care, accuracy and timely follow-up. This role matters because the HR Service Center helps employees navigate internal procedures and Luxembourg administrative requirements with confidence.

Welcome employees at the HR reception and create a professional, well-organised first point of contact.

A bachelor's degree (bac +2/3) in administration, Human Resources or another relevant field.
6 months to 1 year of similar experience in Luxembourg.

French and/or German would be a plus.
Basic / working knowledge of standard IT tools and the ability to document information accurately in internal systems.
Ability to handle HR administrative information with confidentiality and care.

Ways of working

You contribute actively to team efforts, build trust with peers and support shared outcomes.
You respond to employee needs with a service-first mindset and a clear understanding of priorities.
You actively pursue improvement, apply feedback and adapt when processes or priorities change.
You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.

Take your next step

Contribute to an HR Service Center that helps employees move through important administrative moments with clarity, care and trust. Build practical HR knowledge, strengthen your service mindset and collaborate with teams who support people at every step of their PwC journey. Grow here. Go further.

Om du gillar teknik, problemlösning och ett högt tempo kan detta vara rätt roll för dig.

Som Junior Customer Service Agent är du den första kontaktpunkten för kunder och spelare via livechatt, e-post och telefon – där du ger support på både svenska och engelska.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    Delta i en 3 veckors betald onboarding och utbildning
    Hjälpa kunder med snabba, professionella och personliga lösningar
    Identifiera och stötta kunder som behöver hjälp
    Förklara produkter, plattform, policyer och kampanjer
    Uppdatera kundkonton och information vid behov
    Arbeta med ansvarsfullt spelande (Safer Gambling)
    Samarbeta med fraud- och betalningsteam vid behov
    Följa rutiner kring AML och rapportera misstänkt aktivitet

Vi söker dig som

    Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och minst C1-nivå i engelska
    Är flexibel och kan arbeta skift (dag, kväll och natt)
    Har god kommunikationsförmåga och ett empatiskt bemötande
    Är strukturerad och noggrann
    Klarar av att hantera stressiga situationer med en positiv inställning

Förmåner

    Privat sjukförsäkring
    Friskvårdsbidrag upp till €300 per år
    Daglig frukost och lunch i företagets kök
    Extra ledig dag på din födelsedag
    Teamaktiviteter och sociala events
    Relocation-paket till Malta (flyg + två veckors boende)
    Prestationsbonus upp till 10 % av årslön
    Och mycket mer

Om rekryteringsprocessen

Ansökan

title: After-Sales Engineer / Technical Customer Support – Battery Energy Storage Systems (m/f/d) (Kundendienstmonteur/in, -techniker/in)
description:
Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.
• Technische Unterstützung von Installationspartnern während der Inbetriebnahme von Systemen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort.
• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
• Qualifikationen wie VCA, NEN 3140 VP und NEN 1010 sind von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise.
• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.
• Ein teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
• Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle.
• Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
• Moderne Arbeitsplätze und eine offene Unternehmenskultur.
• JobRad und JobTicket.

Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit im zukunftsweisenden Spannungsfeld der Energiewende.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: Callcenter medewerker / Helpdesk Medewerker
description:

Over de functie:
Wij hebben diverse projecten beschikbaar waarbij er mogelijkheden zijn vanaf 20 uur per week. Deels vanuit kantoor en deels vanuit huis is mogelijk, nadat het inwerktraject op kantoor succesvol is doorlopen en jij met een goede rugzak aan kennis en kunde zelfstandig aan de slag kunt.
Sommige projecten zijn service gericht, andere projecten zijn gericht op sales. Samen met jou kunnen we kijken wat het beste bij jou past

Na het inwerktraject op kantoor kun je een mooie verdeling maken tussen het werken vanuit kantoor en thuiswerken, hierdoor kun je flinke reistijd besparen en heb je meer vrije tijd over. En vergeet niet, wanneer je vanuit huis werkt ontvang je ook nog eens een thuiswerkvergoeding!

Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
Je beschikt minimaal over MBO 4 werk- en denkniveau;
Je bent computer vaardig en bent in staat om open gesprekken te voeren;
Je bent beschikbaar van maandag tot en met vrijdag voor minimaal 20 uur per week tussen 8:30 en 21:00 uur.

085-0882340 Yellow Works Tegelen

title: Helpdeskmedewerker
description:
Wij zoeken iemand die ervaring heeft in het klantencontact. Klantvriendelijk is en sociaal. Verder ben je proactief en oplossingsgericht.

Wat is belangrijk?

Je bent communicatief vaardig, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
Je bent computer vaardig en bent in staat om open gesprekken te voeren;
Je bent beschikbaar van maandag tot en met vrijdag voor minimaal 24 uur per week tussen 8:30 en 17:00 uur.

Helpdeskmedewerker
Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken en aantrekkelijke bonussen.

Ben jij klantvriendelijk en sociaal? Weet jij wat klanten willen en weet jij elk gesprek tot een uniek klantbeleving om te toveren? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Over de functie:
Na een inwerktraject van 2 keer 3 dagen met de nodige coaching en begeleiding, kun jij zelfstandig aan de slag. Jij staat klanten zo goed mogelijk te woord en zorgt ervoor dat zij een ultieme klantervaring hebben.
Het is een uitdagende en afwisselende functie, waarbij je minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar bent. Wil jij meer werken, is dit uiteraard geen probleem. Ook dat is mogelijk. Jij wil de beste zijn in je werk en woont hiervoor trainingen en presentaties bij. Jij staat iedere klant te woord en geeft hen die unieke klantbeleving, pas dan ben jij tevreden.

Bij deze functie is het mogelijk om thuis te werken en krijg je het benodigde apparatuur in bruikleen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je voert klantgerichte en op overtuigende wijze in-bound gesprekken met bestaande klanten;
Je beantwoord vragen van klanten, welke onder andere gaan over betalingen, contracten of nota's, welke je daarna administratief verwerkt;
Je past de administratie aan waar nodig, denk aan adresgegevens, verhuizing en opzegging.

title: Landmeter / maatvoerder gezocht
description:
Als landmeetkundig medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van projecten. Je werkt zelfstandig in het veld en voert alle voorkomende landmeetkundige werkzaamheden uit zoals grondslagmetingen, detailmetingen, hoogtemetingen, monitoring/deformatiemetingen en voert diverse uitzetwerkzaamheden uit. Wij gaan ervan uit dat je kunt werken met een Total Station en kennis hebt van GPS-apparatuur. Daarnaast verwerk je efficiënt en accuraat de ingewonnen gegevens. Nauwkeurigheid, precisie en oog voor details zijn hierbij zeer belangrijk.
Bedrijfsprofiel: Geonique beschikt over een unieke kennis, ervaring en expertise op het gebied van infrastructurele en bouwkundige projecten. Ieder bouwwerk is maatwerk en juist dit is ons specialisme. Op het gebied van geodesie (zowel op land als op het water) dragen wij zorg voor het inwinnen, verwerken, uitzetten, bewerken, analyseren, optimaliseren, creëren en presenteren van 3D-geodata. Het inwinnen gebeurd met de meest moderne apparatuur. Naast terreinmetingen en inmetingen van bestaande infra vertaald Geonique ook het ontwerp naar het veld door het verzorgen van uitzetwerk of de modellen voor GPS- machinebesturing. Tevens ondersteunen wij ook industrie, utiliteits en woningsbouwprojecten met onze kennis op gebied van maatvoering. Denk hierbij aan het inmeten of uitzetten van funderingen, staalconstructies, sonderingen, boringen, gevels of inpandige metingen.

title: Aankomend landmeter / maatvoerder gezocht
description:
Om het landmeten goed te leren ga je met een ervaren landmeter op pad om hem te assisteren bij zijn werkzaamheden. Denk hierbij aan waterpassen, detailmetingen, maatvoeren, metingen uitvoeren. As an Assembly Cleanroom Operator in Alkmaar, you will work in a cleanroom environment similar to a laboratory. You will be responsible for cleaning, assembling, testing, and packaging technical components used in high-tech machines, primarily for the semiconductor industry. Your tasks include carefully cleaning parts such as pipes and hoses using special wipes, cleaning baths, and sometimes ovens to remove all contamination. You will then assemble the components using technical drawings, which only show the final product, requiring technical insight and a willingness to learn. Internal training will be provided. Next, you will test components, such as hoses, to ensure they are leak-proof. Finally, you will double-pack and label the products according to strict guidelines. You will always wear full protective cleanroom clothing, with only your face visible. Precision and discipline are crucial. Your day will be varied, and you will work according to clear procedures. You will work 40 hours a week in a team of technical colleagues. If you enjoy working with technical products and want to enhance your skills, this is your opportunity. Do you want to work in a clean, modern environment and learn more about the high-tech industry? Apply now and start your future in technology!

Mendix, a Siemens business, powers hybrid agentic workforces by enabling
organizations to build, scale and orchestrate agents and applications faster by
combining low-code, AI, data, and integrations into a unified platform.
The Technical Solutions Marketing team builds technical
credibility for Mendix through validated architectures, reusable proof points,
and real-world implementations. In this role, you will work directly with
customers and the field to prove high-value use cases through lighthouse
implementations, then package what works into reusable patterns, components,
and technical narratives that scale across GTM and delivery ecosystems.

Responsibilities

- Design
and build knowledge graphs and ontologies that underpin Mendix's AI
solutions, technical demos, and customer implementations.
- Own
the data and graph architecture workstream within integrated team
solutions, working alongside Solutions Engineers who cover the application
and AI layers.
- Turn
validated customer work into reusable assets: reference architectures,
blueprints, accelerators, and repeatable patterns.
- Contribute
to customer engagements, events, and analyst briefings as the team's
expert in data and graph.
- Ground
GTM positioning and storytelling in validated technical proof points,
supporting high-impact moments like executive demos and analyst briefings.

Requirements

- Demonstrable
hands-on experience designing and building knowledge graphs and
ontologies.
- Strong
understanding of graph data modelling, semantic modelling, and ontology
design.
- Experience
with graph database platforms and query languages (e.g. SPARQL, Cypher, or
equivalent).
- Data
engineering fundamentals: pipelines, data preparation, and integration
with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, operational systems).
- Ability
to translate data and graph architectures into reusable patterns and clear
technical narratives.
- Strong
communication and collaboration skills across Product, GTM, engineering,
and customer stakeholders.

Note: This is not a data analyst or business
intelligence role. The focus is graph data, knowledge modelling, and how that
layer supports AI and agentic applications.
What Success Looks Like

- Knowledge
graph demos and reference architectures that hold up in customer and
analyst sessions and are ready to reuse across the team.
- Recognised
as the team's go-to on data and graph in customer engagements.
- Packaged
architectures adopted by the team and reused across go-to-market and
delivery.
- Implementation
learnings feeding product direction and positioning in a consistent way.

Why this role
This role sits at the foundation of agentic enterprise
solutions are grounded in real data, and plays a central part in how knowledge
graph architectures are proven, packaged, and scaled.
You will design the graph layer that gives AI agents
structured context and memory at enterprise scale, work alongside the
application and AI Solutions Engineers to take those implementations in front
of customers and analysts, and feed what you learn back into Product and Go To
Market teams.

title: Vertriebsaußendienst Ventiltechnik BeNeLux (m/w/d) (Außendienstmitarbeiter/in)
description:
Ventiltechnik verbindet Märkte und Menschen

Vertriebsaußendienst Ventiltechnik BeNeLux (m/w/d) in Eindhoven

Als spezialisierte Personalvermittlung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau unterstützen wir aktuell ein international tätiges Unternehmen bei der Besetzung einer spannenden Vertriebsposition im BeNeLux-Raum. Gesucht wird eine*n Sales Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich Ventiltechnik für die Märkte Niederlande und Belgien. Unser Kunde entwickelt und vertreibt magnetgesteuerte Ventile, druckgesteuerte Systeme sowie individuelle Lösungen für industrielle Anwendungen. Die Position bietet viel Gestaltungsspielraum, internationale Kundenkontakte und wird durch uns im Rahmen einer Direktanstellung beim Kunden besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Sie betreuen Bestandskunden in den Niederlanden und Belgien technisch und vertrieblich.
- Sie bauen bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt aus und gewinnen neue Geschäftspartner.
- Sie beraten Kunden zu Ventiltechnik, Fluidlösungen und individuellen Systemanwendungen.
- Sie analysieren technische Anforderungen und entwickeln passende Lösungskonzepte.
- Sie koordinieren Projekte gemeinsam mit internen Fachabteilungen und begleiten Angebote bis zum Abschluss.
- Sie beobachten Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und identifizieren neue Vertriebspotenziale.

Ihr Profil:

- Sie verfügen über eine technische oder technisch-kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Fluidtechnik, Maschinenbau oder Automatisierungstechnik.
- Sie bringen Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte mit.
- Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten beim Kunden.
- Sie besitzen Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ein gutes technisches Verständnis für industrielle Anwendungen.
- Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der BeNeLux-Region sowie idealerweise ein Wohnsitz in den Niederlanden.

Was unser Kunde bietet:

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum im internationalen Vertrieb.
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Prozesse und Märkte.
- Spannende Kundenprojekte im industriellen Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.
- Ein wertschätzendes, mittelständisch geprägtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
- Attraktive Vergütung sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten:

- Persönliche Beratung und individuelle Begleitung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses.
- Zugang zu exklusiven Positionen im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau mit internationalem Umfeld.
- Direkte Vermittlung in eine langfristige Festanstellung bei unserem Kunden.
- Vertrauliche und professionelle Betreuung mit transparenter Kommunikation.
- Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf Gespräche sowie während aller weiteren Prozessschritte.

Unser Kunde steht für technische Präzision, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und nachhaltige Lösungen im industriellen Umfeld. Durch langjährige Erfahrung in der Ventil- und Fluidtechnik bietet das Unternehmen stabile Strukturen, internationale Marktpräsenz und moderne Vertriebsprozesse. Mitarbeitende profitieren von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem Umfeld, das Innovation, Teamgeist und persönliche Weiterentwicklung aktiv fördert.

description:

Stellenbeschreibung:
Du möchtest jeden Tag an etwas anderem arbeiten? Von Trinkwasseranlagen bis hin zu industriellen Prozesswasseranlagen bei namhaften Kunden aus der Lebensmittel-, Getränke- und Industriebranche? Du analysierst technische Störungen mit klarem Blick, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und möchtest eigenverantwortlich unterwegs sein?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

RWB Water ist Spezialist für industrielle Wasseraufbereitung und entwickelt, baut sowie betreibt Anlagen für Trinkwasser-, Prozesswasser- und Abwasseranwendungen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Serviceteams suchen wir einen engagierten Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

- Dein Arbeitstag beginnt direkt von zu Hause aus. Über das digitale Einsatzsystem erhältst du deine Aufträge und startest eigenständig zu unseren Kunden.
- Zu unseren Kunden gehören Wasserwerke, Krankenhäuser, Brauereien, Lebensmittelproduzenten sowie Industrieunternehmen.
- Durchführung von Wartungs-, Service- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen
- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen beim Kunden vor Ort
- Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe neuer Anlagen
- Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungen gemäß Wartungsplänen
- Unterstützung bei Umbauten, Optimierungen und kleineren Modifikationen
- Dokumentation der Serviceeinsätze und technischen Arbeiten
- Technische Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden
- Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst im rotierenden System - einmal in 8 Wochen

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker, Anlagenmechaniker oder Elektroniker
- Berufserfahrung im technischen Service oder Anlagenbau von Vorteil
- Technisches Verständnis in Mechanik, Pumpentechnik, Rohrleitungsbau oder Elektrotechnik
- Erfahrung im Bereich Wasseraufbereitung oder Verfahrenstechnik ist wünschenswert
- Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und Teamfähigkeit
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Reisebereitschaft im regionalen Einsatzgebiet

Das bieten wir dir

- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem international tätigen Unternehmen
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
- Intensive Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Modern ausgestattetes Servicefahrzeug
- Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Zuschlägen für Bereitschaftsdienste
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel wie Laptop und Mobiltelefon
- Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
- Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe
- Attraktives Jahresgehalt von 36 T€ bis 60 T€ – entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Über uns

Die RWB Water Gruppe entwickelt nachhaltige Lösungen für industrielle und kommunale Wasseraufbereitung. Als Teil der internationalen METAWATER Group verbinden wir mittelständische Strukturen mit internationaler Technologiekompetenz.

title: Senior E-Bike Mechanic (m,f) (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
description:
Start: asap

We are partnering with a fast-growing European startup that is building the largest marketplace for refurbished e-bikes globally. Having refurbished over 100,000 e-bikes in just a few years, the company is expanding rapidly and is now looking for a Senior E-Bike Mechanic to join its refurbishment centre in Amsterdam.

In this role, you will work exclusively with e-bikes in a modern workshop environment, restoring a wide range of models to excellent condition and ensuring consistently high quality standards.

Your Role

- Managing the entire refurbishment and repair cycle of e-bikes, from initial inspection and fault diagnosis to spare parts selection and repair execution
- Acting as a technical authority, determining the appropriate scope of repairs based on expertise and quality requirements
- Performing detailed quality controls to ensure all refurbished e-bikes meet high standards before delivery
- Contributing advanced technical knowledge in e-bike hardware and software systems
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives to optimize repair processes and overall product quality
- Collaborating closely with the workshop team and contributing ideas to improve workflows and efficiency

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as an e-bike mechanic, bicycle mechanic, two-wheel mechanic, mechatronics technician, automotive mechanic, or in a comparable technical field
- Completed vocational training or apprenticeship in a relevant discipline is an advantage; experienced career changers with strong technical expertise are also welcome
- Highly organized, precise, and comfortable working independently
- Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset
- Good communication skills in English and/or Dutch

The Offer

- Work on a wide variety of e-bikes, including city, cargo, mountain, and speed models, across multiple brands and systems
- Modern workshop with state-of-the-art tools, diagnostic equipment, and electric work stands
- Experienced team environment with strong knowledge sharing
- No customer interaction — full focus on technical excellence
- Weekends off, with work scheduled only on weekdays
- Competitive fixed monthly salary
- Performance reviews every six months with clear opportunities for career progression
- Dynamic startup environment with long-term growth and development opportunities
